verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell it for 1,000 coins, or recycle for 16 Chemicals if you are short.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 1000 钱币；缺化学品时可拆成 16 个。

obtain.en: Only The Queen and Sentinel drop it. The Queen needs a Harvester map condition; Sentinels sit at Outer Gates (The Blue Gate) and Breach (Dam Battlegrounds) and are more common in Hurricane.
obtain.zh: 只有女王和哨卫掉落。女王要在“收割者”地图条件下才出现；哨卫常驻蓝门外部大门、大坝战场裂口一带，飓风天气更多。

tips.en: Recycling gives 16 Chemicals, nearly twice the 9 from salvaging in a raid, so do it at the workshop. Chemicals are cheap, so the 1,000 sale price is the better payout.
tips.zh: 工作台回收得 16 个化学品，局内拆解只有 9 个。化学品便宜，卖 1000 更划算。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 1,000 coins, or recycle for 16 Rubber Parts if you are short.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 1000 钱币；缺橡胶零件时可拆成 16 个。

obtain.en: Drops from Matriarch, The Queen and Leaper. Leapers are the realistic farm: they spawn on Dam Battlegrounds (most spots), Buried City, The Spaceport, The Blue Gate and Riven Tides, not on Stella Montis.
obtain.zh: 掉落自族母、女王和跳跃者。跳跃者最现实：大坝战场刷新点最多，掩埋废城、太空港、蓝门、裂潮镇也有，星辰山没有。

tips.en: Rubber Parts are common elsewhere, so only recycle if you are short; otherwise the 1,000 sale price is the easier win.
tips.zh: 橡胶零件别处很好找，缺才拆；否则直接卖 1000 更省事。

tips.en: Leapers die fast to a Blaze Grenade followed by one or two Heavy Ammo shots, which makes this one of the cheaper rares to farm.
tips.zh: 用火焰手雷加一两发重型弹药就能放倒跳跃者，是比较省成本的稀有材料来源。

verdict.en: Keep 10 for Trophy Display phase 3 and 1 for To The Skies; the rest recycles into 12 Metal Parts or sells for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 留 10 个给战利品展示架第 3 阶段，“飞向苍穹”要 1 个；其余拆成 12 个金属零件或卖 1000。

obtain.en: Never in containers; it comes from big ARC: Matriarch, The Queen and Leaper (also Bastion and Bombardier, per player guides). Leapers on Dam Battlegrounds and The Spaceport are the steadiest source; Matriarchs need their map condition.
obtain.zh: 容器里没有，只来自大型 ARC：族母、女王、跳跃者（玩家攻略还提到堡垒、投弹手）。大坝战场和太空港的跳跃者最稳；族母需要对应地图条件。

tips.en: Trophy Display phase 3 needs 10 and To The Skies rewards 3, so you may already be partway there.
tips.zh: 战利品展示架第 3 阶段要 10 个，“飞向苍穹”还送 3 个，你可能已经有一部分了。

tips.en: After the projects, 12 Metal Parts is poor value against a 1,000 sale. Just sell.
tips.zh: 项目做完后，12 个金属零件远不如卖 1000，直接卖。

verdict.en: Keep 10 for Trophy Display phase 4 and 1 for To The Skies; the rest recycles into 14 Plastic Parts or sells for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 留 10 个给战利品展示架第 4 阶段，“飞向苍穹”要 1 个；其余拆成 14 个塑料零件或卖 1000。

obtain.en: Matriarch, The Queen, Sentinel and Snitch drop it. Snitch is the easy one: it patrols open areas on any map, dies to a few Medium or Heavy Ammo shots, and its reinforcement calls give you more wrecks to loot.
obtain.zh: 族母、女王、哨卫和告密者掉落。告密者最容易：各图空旷处都有，几发中型或重型弹药就倒，召来的增援也能多摸几具残骸。

tips.en: Hunt Snitches early in the raid, before they call reinforcements: reinforcements only come reliably after the third call.
tips.zh: 趁告密者还没叫援军就解决：第三次呼叫后才会稳定增援。

verdict.en: Needed by three projects (6+10+15) and To The Skies; keep until they are done, then sell for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 三个项目共要 31 个（6+10+15）外加“飞向苍穹”，做完前别动，之后卖 1000。

obtain.en: Dropped by The Queen, Sentinel and Pop. Pops usually sit in large indoor facilities next to Fireballs and are killed with a fast-firing weapon at close range.
obtain.zh: 女王、哨卫和爆爆掉落。爆爆多在大型室内设施里与火球同行，近距离用高射速武器解决。

tips.en: Running past a Pop at full speed wastes its detonation, so you can loot it without losing health.
tips.zh: 全速跑过爆爆可让它空爆，之后安全摸尸。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 5,000 coins, or recycle into 4 Advanced ARC Powercells.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 5000 钱币，或拆成 4 个高级ARC能量电池。

obtain.en: Only from Assessor containers during the Close Scrutiny map condition (not on Stella Montis). Assessors show three red beams; loot each breach platform when it activates and bring smoke.
obtain.zh: 只在“严密排查”地图条件下从评估者的容器里出（星辰山没有）。评估者会射出三道红光；每个平台激活就摸，带烟雾弹。

tips.en: Recycling also returns 1 Advanced Mechanical Components, so recycle only if you need those parts; otherwise the sale is simpler.
tips.zh: 拆解还会多给 1 个高级机械元件；缺这些零件再拆，否则直接卖更省事。

verdict.en: Keep 12 for Gear Bench 3 (6), Settled in Full (1) and Trophy Display (5); extras are only 3 ARC Alloy.
verdict.zh: 装备工作台 3 级要 6 个，债务结清 1 个，战利品展示架 5 个（共约 12 个）；多余的只能拆出 3 个ARC合金。

obtain.en: Only from scavenging a destroyed Bastion; it is not in containers. Bastions stand in open ground on every map: east of Water Treatment Control and Red Lakes Balcony (Dam), Marano Park (Buried City), Outer Gates (Blue Gate), under Cielo Sereno Observatory (Pendola Pass).
obtain.zh: 只能从击毁的堡垒身上摸，容器里没有。各图开阔地都有：大坝战场水处理控制中心东侧、红湖阳台，掩埋废城马拉诺公园，蓝门外部大门，彭多拉山口天文台下。

tips.en: Shoot the yellow knee joints and rear canister; destroying the canister exposes a weak spot. A Deadline mine placed near the canister kills it outright.
tips.zh: 打黄色膝关节和后部罐体，罐体被毁会露出弱点。在罐体旁放“死线”地雷可直接秒杀。

verdict.en: Keep 6 for Refiner 3 plus the Bombing Run quest; Trophy Display phase 5 wants 8 more.
verdict.zh: 精加工机 3 级要 6 个，另有“以下犯上”任务；战利品展示架第 5 阶段还要 8 个。

obtain.en: Salvage it from a destroyed Bombardier. Spots: Primary Facility at night (Dam), Marano Park and Plaza Rosa (Buried City), The Trench (Spaceport), Traffic Tunnel (Blue Gate), Dried Riverbed (Riven Tides).
obtain.zh: 从击毁的投弹手身上摸。位置：大坝战场主要设施（夜袭），掩埋废城马拉诺公园和玫瑰广场，太空港壕沟，蓝门交通隧道，裂潮镇干涸河床。

tips.en: Kill its Spotter drones first and attack right after it fires its mortar. A Deadline mine at its canister finishes it fast.
tips.zh: 先打掉它的侦察员无人机，趁它刚发射迫击炮时输出。罐体旁的“死线”地雷能迅速解决它。

verdict.en: A 2.0 item you need 6 of for Research Station 3, plus one for Bait, Fetch, Blast; sell extras at 5,000.
verdict.zh: 研究站 3 级要 6 个，“诱饵、搜寻、爆破”再要 1 个；多余的卖 5000。

obtain.en: Dropped by Bully (Pendola Pass, around Piazza della Rupe) and by Couriers. Bullies patrol, so check Railroad Junction, Almatera Station and the Northern Tracks snowfields.
obtain.zh: 恶霸（彭多拉山口，岩石广场一带）和 ARC运输机掉落。恶霸会巡逻，可去铁路枢纽、阿尔玛特拉站、北部轨道雪原找。

tips.en: Aim at its leg joints, and at the head while it fires. Body shots waste ammo.
tips.zh: 打腿部关节，开火时打头部，打躯干浪费弹药。

tips.en: Recycling returns just 1 ARC Alloy and 1 Explosive Compound, far below the 5,000 sale value.
tips.zh: 拆解只得 1 个ARC合金和 1 个炸药混合物，远不如卖 5000。

verdict.en: Pure fodder: nothing needs it, so sell for 640 or recycle into 2 ARC Alloy only if you need alloy.
verdict.zh: 纯杂物，没有任何需求，卖 640；缺ARC合金才拆成 2 个。

obtain.en: Found by scavenging ARC Couriers (breachable containers) and Baron Husks.
obtain.zh: 来自 ARC运输机（需破拆的容器）和“男爵”残骸。

tips.en: It weighs 1 and stacks to 3, so do not carry it just to sell unless the bag has room.
tips.zh: 重量 1、堆叠 3，背包紧张就别专门带回去卖。

verdict.en: Worth hunting: 3 for Nothing Ventured, 1 for Collision Course and Deadline, plus two projects; extras sell for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 值得专门去打：“焉得虎子”3 个，“碰撞航线”和“死线”各 1 个，另有两个项目要。

obtain.en: Only from a Comet killed before it self-destructs (the core piece). Comets roam open ground; Dam Battlegrounds standard raids lost them in an older patch. Seeker Grenades strip armor, then shoot the exposed core as it charges.
obtain.zh: 必须在彗星自爆前击毁才有（核心部分）。彗星在开阔地游荡，旧版本起大坝战场普通场次不再出现。用追踪手雷剥甲，在它蓄力暴露核心时射击。

tips.en: If it explodes first only the ring is lootable, and that gives common ARC parts. Back off before it detonates.
tips.zh: 它先自爆就只能摸到环状部件，只有普通材料，蓄力时赶紧拉开距离。

verdict.en: Sell it for 640; recycling gives only 2 ARC Alloy and nothing needs it.
verdict.zh: 卖 640；拆只得 2 个ARC合金，也没人需要它。

obtain.en: Common loot on mid and large ARC wrecks, such as Leapers, Bastions and Sentinels. Light at 0.25 weight, so grab it when passing.
obtain.zh: 常见于跳跃者、堡垒、哨卫等中大型 ARC 残骸。重量仅 0.25，顺手拿。

verdict.en: Low-value junk: sell it for 293 or recycle for 1 ARC Alloy.
verdict.zh: 低价杂物：卖 293，或拆成 1 个ARC合金。

obtain.en: Drops from almost every ARC wreck, so it does not need a dedicated trip.
obtain.zh: 几乎所有 ARC 残骸都会掉，不用专门去找。

tips.en: It stacks to 5 at 0.25 weight, so it is a fine filler when the bag has room, but leave it for a better pickup if space is tight.
tips.zh: 堆叠 5、重量 0.25，有空位可以带；背包紧张时让位给更值钱的东西。

verdict.en: Sell for 270 or recycle into 1 ARC Alloy; nothing needs it.
verdict.zh: 卖 270，或拆成 1 个ARC合金，没有需求。

obtain.en: Left by wrecked Fireballs, which sit in bunkers, underground areas and Buried City metro entrances. Destroying one starts a fire, so step back.
obtain.zh: 火球残骸掉落，火球多在地堡、地下，以及掩埋废城地铁入口。击毁会引燃周围，注意后退。

tips.en: Throwing a full Fireball Burner leaves this item behind, so the intact one is the part to keep for Refiner 2.
tips.zh: 投掷完好的“火球”燃烧炉后会留下这个受损版，精加工机 2 级要的是完好版。

verdict.en: Keep 2 for Utility Station 2; sell the rest at 1,000 coins.
verdict.zh: 工具工作台 2 级要 2 个；其余卖 1000 钱币。

obtain.en: Not from ARC. The wiki says Server Racks; player guides point to Launch Tower tops (Spaceport), Assembly Workshops (Stella Montis), Dam Research & Administration and Pilgrim's Peak (Blue Gate).
obtain.zh: 不是 ARC 掉的。维基说服务器机架；玩家攻略指向太空港发射塔顶、星辰山组装厂车间、大坝研究行政楼、蓝门朝圣峰。

tips.en: It weighs 2, the heaviest item here, so pick it up only when you need it or the sale is clearly worth the space.
tips.zh: 重量 2，同类里最重，需要时再拿。

verdict.en: Sell for 640; recycling returns only 2 ARC Alloy.
verdict.zh: 卖 640；拆只得 2 个ARC合金。

obtain.en: Dropped by wrecked Hornets, which patrol in small swarms with Wasps and Fireflies. Destroy their armored front thrusters with Medium or Heavy Ammo.
obtain.zh: 被击毁的马蜂掉落，马蜂与黄蜂、萤火虫成群巡逻。用中型或重型弹药打掉前部装甲推进器。

tips.en: Destroyed Hornets are also a good source of Medium Ammo.
tips.zh: 击毁马蜂还能补充中型弹药。

verdict.en: Sell it for 1,000, or recycle for 3 ARC Alloy; it is the best of the damaged drivers.
verdict.zh: 卖 1000，或拆成 3 个ARC合金；受损引擎里数它最值。

obtain.en: From downed Rocketeers, which are posted at high-value spots. Knock out two thrusters to make it fall, or ground it with a Showstopper.
obtain.zh: 来自击落的火箭手，常驻高价值地点。打掉两个推进器使其坠落，或用“耀眼明星”手雷压地。

tips.en: A Rocketeer also drops Launcher Ammo, so the kill pays twice.
tips.zh: 火箭手还掉榴弹发射器弹药，一次击杀两份收益。

verdict.en: Sell for 659: it cannot be recycled.
verdict.zh: 卖 659，它不能回收。

obtain.en: Left by wrecked Snitches, which scout ahead and call reinforcements. Take it out quickly with Medium or Heavy Ammo.
obtain.zh: 告密者残骸掉落，它会先行侦察并叫援军，用中型或重型弹药迅速击落。

verdict.en: Sell for 270 or recycle into 1 ARC Alloy; no workshop use.
verdict.zh: 卖 270，或拆成 1 个ARC合金，没有工坊用途。

obtain.en: Dropped by Ticks, which cling to walls and ceilings indoors and often come in groups. One melee hit kills one, which saves ammo.
obtain.zh: 跳蚤掉落，它们爬在室内墙壁和天花板上，常成群出现。近战一击可杀，省弹药。

tips.en: If one latches onto you, hold interact to shake it off before it lunges again.
tips.zh: 被扑上身时按住交互键甩开，免得再次被扑。

verdict.en: Sell for 270 or recycle into 1 ARC Alloy; this is the cheapest of the ARC parts.
verdict.zh: 卖 270，或拆成 1 个ARC合金；这是最便宜的 ARC 零件。

obtain.en: Wasps patrol open outdoor areas and have only 110 health. Shoot their thrusters, and they crash into the ground and fall apart.
obtain.zh: 黄蜂在室外开阔地巡逻，只有 110 点生命。打推进器，它们会失控坠地损毁。

tips.en: Wasps also drop Light Ammo, a decent reason to take them down even though the part is cheap.
tips.zh: 黄蜂还掉轻型弹药，零件虽便宜，击落也不亏。

verdict.en: Sell it for 640, or recycle for 11 Rubber Parts if you are short on rubber.
verdict.zh: 卖 640；缺橡胶时可拆成 11 个橡胶零件。

obtain.en: Found on ARC wrecks. The areas tagged ARC loot are Old Battleground (23 container spots in an ordinary round) and the Controlled Access Zone (22) on Dam Battlegrounds, the Wreckage on Riven Tides (17) and Barren Clearing on The Blue Gate (8).
obtain.zh: 来自ARC残骸。标为ARC类物资的区域有大坝战场的旧战场（普通对局约23个容器点）和受控访问区（约22个）、裂潮镇的残骸（约17个）以及蓝门的荒芜空地（约8个）。

tips.en: Recycling at the workshop gives 11 Rubber Parts versus 5 from salvaging in a raid.
tips.zh: 工作台回收得 11 个橡胶零件，局内拆解只有 5 个。

verdict.en: No workshop or quest needs it; sell for 640 or recycle for 9 Plastic Parts.
verdict.zh: 没有工坊或任务需要，卖 640，或拆成 9 个塑料零件。

obtain.en: Comes from scavenging old Baron Husks. The wiki gives no map.
obtain.zh: 来自搜刮旧的“男爵”残骸，维基未给出地图。

tips.en: Recycling at the workshop gives 9 Plastic Parts versus 4 from salvaging in a raid.
tips.zh: 工作台回收得 9 个塑料零件，局内拆解只有 4 个。

verdict.en: Keep 8 for Refiner 2 and 1 for Test Case; extras are worth little, so sell or recycle them.
verdict.zh: 精加工机 2 级要 8 个，“测试案例”要 1 个；多余的价值不高，卖掉或拆掉。

obtain.en: Salvaged from a destroyed Fireball. They stay in bunkers and underground, such as Buried City metro entrances and the large Blue Gate bunker. Shoot the core when its front panel opens.
obtain.zh: 从击毁的火球身上摸。火球多在地堡和地下，如掩埋废城地铁入口、蓝门大地堡。等它前部面板打开时射击核心。

tips.en: Use Medium or Heavy Ammo on the shell; Light Ammo bounces off.
tips.zh: 对外壳用中型或重型弹药，轻型弹药会弹开。

tips.en: Throwing it makes a small fire but leaves a Damaged Fireball Burner, so save the intact one for the upgrade.
tips.zh: 投掷会起小火，并留下受损的“火球”燃烧炉，完好的留给升级。

verdict.en: Keep 1 for Test Case; everything else sells for 1,000 coins.
verdict.zh: “测试案例”要 1 个；其余全部卖 1000 钱币。

obtain.en: Salvaged from destroyed Fireflies, which reinforce Wasp and Hornet patrols. Shoot the unarmored fuel tank and step away on death, since it ignites the area.
obtain.zh: 从击毁的萤火虫身上摸，它常加入黄蜂和马蜂的巡逻。射击无装甲的燃料罐，死亡会引燃周围，要立刻离开。

tips.en: Also an ingredient for the Trailblazer, but it needs the blueprint.
tips.zh: 也是“开拓者”的材料，但需要蓝图。

verdict.en: A 5,000-coin legendary with no live use: sell it.
verdict.zh: 5000 钱币的传说级，现在没有用途：卖掉。

obtain.en: The wiki lists Erratic Wasps (most common), Leaper, Pop and Snitch. A guide recommends Transfer Depot in Riven Tides for solo farming and Buried City for teams. The project window may have closed, so check in game.
obtain.zh: 维基列出异常黄蜂（最常见）、跳跃者、爆爆和告密者。一份攻略推荐单人去裂潮镇转运站刷，组队去掩埋废城；该项目可能已结束，请自行确认。

tips.en: Recycling gives 6 ARC Alloy and an Exodus Module, which is less than the sale price.
tips.zh: 拆解得 6 个ARC合金和 1 个离巢模块，不如直接卖。

verdict.en: Event leftover: the Phantom Targets project it fed is over, so sell it for 3,000.
verdict.zh: 活动遗留品：它对应的“幻影目标”项目已结束，直接卖 3000。

obtain.en: Only Erratic Wasps (the glitched Wasp variant) drop it, most often when you scavenge the wreck. Normal Wasps do not. Dam Battlegrounds' swampy approaches were the popular hunting ground during the event.
obtain.zh: 只有故障版黄蜂的残骸会出，普通黄蜂不出。活动期间大坝战场的沼泽一带曾是热门猎场。

tips.en: Recycling gives 1 Advanced Electrical Component and 3 ARC Alloy, which is worth less than the sale price.
tips.zh: 拆解只得 1 个高级电子元件和 3 个ARC合金，不如直接卖。

verdict.en: Event leftover from the finished Phantom Targets project: sell it for 2,000.
verdict.zh: 已结束的“幻影目标”活动遗留品：卖 2000。

obtain.en: Dropped by Erratic Wasps, the glitched Wasp variant, when you scavenge the wreck; it is the only listed source. Aim at the Wasp's central body so the wreck lands where you can reach it.
obtain.zh: 故障版黄蜂残骸掉落，是唯一已知来源。打中央机身，残骸才不会飘到够不着的地方。

tips.en: Recycling gives 3 ARC Alloy and 2 Sensors, which is worth less than selling.
tips.zh: 拆解得 3 个ARC合金和 2 个传感器，不如卖。

verdict.en: Low-value event leftover: sell it, or recycle for 3 ARC Alloy if you need alloy.
verdict.zh: 低价值活动遗留品：卖掉，或缺ARC合金时拆成 3 个。

obtain.en: Mostly from Erratic Wasps; the wiki also lists Fireballs, Hornets and Pops as sources. It is the easiest glitched part to come by.
obtain.zh: 主要来自故障版黄蜂；维基还列出火球、马蜂和爆爆。是最容易拿到的故障零件。

tips.en: The project that used these, Phantom Targets Part 2, is over, so there is no reason to hoard.
tips.zh: 用到它的“幻影目标”第 2 部分已结束，没必要囤。

verdict.en: Sell it for 1,000; recycling gives one alloy and one electrical component, which is worth less.
verdict.zh: 卖 1000；拆出 1 合金 1 电子元件更不值。

obtain.en: Mainly from Erratic Wasps, and occasionally from Pops. Kill glitched Wasps in open ground and scavenge the wreck.
obtain.zh: 主要来自故障版黄蜂，爆爆偶尔也出。在开阔地击落故障黄蜂并搜残骸。

tips.en: The Phantom Targets project that used these has ended, so sell rather than keep.
tips.zh: 用到它的“幻影目标”项目已结束，直接卖，别留。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for the Gear Bench level 2 upgrade, plus one for Test Case; after that it sells for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 留 5 个升装备工作台 2 级，再留 1 个给“测试案例”，其余卖 1000。

use.en: It doubles as a throwable: it stuns ARC for 7 seconds in a 6 m radius, and raiders for only half a second. Handy for freezing a Surveyor so it can't flee.
use.zh: 也能当投掷物：6 米内让 ARC 眩晕 7 秒，对奇袭者仅 0.5 秒。可以定住想逃跑的ARC勘测师。

obtain.en: Kill Hornets and scavenge the wreck. Hit the unarmored rear thrusters; medium or heavy ammo punches through the front armor. Couriers can also drop it.
obtain.zh: 击落马蜂后搜残骸。打没有装甲的后推进器；中、重型弹药能破前装甲。ARC运输机也可能掉。

tips.en: The Trophy Display project phase 2 wants 15 more, and the Showstopper and Surge Coil recipes use one each, so don't recycle early.
tips.zh: 战利品展示架第 2 阶段还要 15 个，耀眼明星和涌能线圈也各用 1 个，别急着拆。

verdict.en: Recycle it if you need 12 Chemicals; otherwise sell it for 640. Nothing in the workshop needs it.
verdict.zh: 缺化学品就拆（12 个），否则卖 640。工作台不需要它。

obtain.en: Comes from Baron Husk wrecks, which must be breached open. They are trapped and also hold other ARC scrap, so check the loot before leaving.
obtain.zh: 来自“男爵”残骸，需要破拆，且带陷阱。里面还有其他 ARC 废料，出来前看一眼。

tips.en: Recycling at the workshop gives 12 Chemicals, salvaging in a raid only 5, so carry it home.
tips.zh: 工作台回收得 12 个化学品，局内拆解只有 5 个，带回基地再拆。

verdict.en: Keep it: Utility Station level 3 and several late projects want it, and it sells for a solid 3,000.
verdict.zh: 留着：工具工作台 3 级和多个后期项目都要，卖也有 3000。

use.en: It can be thrown for a 100-damage, 10 m blast that drags players in. Mostly, though, treat it as an upgrade material.
use.zh: 可当手雷扔出，10 米范围造成 100 点伤害并拉拽玩家。但主要还是升级材料。

obtain.en: Leapers show up on Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City, The Spaceport, The Blue Gate and Riven Tides, not Stella Montis. On the Dam, patrol routes east of the Hydroponic Dome Complex and near the Water Treatment elevator work. Burn it with Blaze Grenades, then finish with heavy ammo.
obtain.zh: 跳跃者出没于大坝战场、掩埋废城、太空港、蓝门和裂潮镇，星辰山没有。大坝可去水培穹顶综合体以东和水处理电梯附近。燃烧手雷加重型弹药解决。

tips.en: Utility Station L3 needs 4, Into the Fray 1, and Trophy Display phase 3 another 10. Put it in your Safe Pocket.
tips.zh: 工具工作台 3 级要 4 个，“投入战斗”1 个，展示架第 3 阶段 10 个。放进安全口袋。

verdict.en: Keep one for the Aphelion and the Nothing Gained quest; extras are 11,000 coins each, and the boss fight is the cost.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个做远日点和“不入虎穴”；多的每个卖 11000。

use.en: Craft the Aphelion at Gunsmith level 3 with the blueprint. The Trophy Display project phase 5 also asks for 3.
use.zh: 武器工作台 3 级配合蓝图可制作远日点。战利品展示架第 5 阶段还要 3 个。

obtain.en: The Matriarch only spawns while its map condition is active, then roams ARC territory. Fight from high ground or solid cover, break the faceplates, then shoot the exposed red core. The rocket barrage is the real danger. Loot fast: other raiders swarm the wreck.
obtain.zh: 族母只在对应地图条件开启时出现。占据高点或掩体，打碎面甲后射击暴露的红色核心。火箭齐射最危险。快速搜刮，别人会来抢。

tips.en: Ignore the legs and don't shoot into its energy shield; wait for it to drop. Without its escort, the fight gets easy.
tips.zh: 别打腿，能量护盾开着时先别开火。护卫清掉后战斗会轻松很多。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for Explosives Station level 2 and 1 for To The Skies; the rest sell for 640.
verdict.zh: 留 5 个升爆炸物工作台 2 级、1 个给“飞向苍穹”，其余卖 640。

obtain.en: Pops are rolling kamikaze drones found mostly indoors in large facilities, usually next to Fireballs. Shoot them with a fast-firing weapon at close range, or just sprint past at full speed and they blow up harmlessly.
obtain.zh: 爆爆是滚动自爆机器，多在大型室内设施，常与火球同行。近距离用速射武器打，或全速跑过，它会无害引爆。

tips.en: Trophy Display phase 1 asks for 15 and Fireworks Box recipes use 3 each. Hold until those are done.
tips.zh: 展示架第 1 阶段要 15 个，烟花箱配方各用 3 个。做完再处理多余的。

verdict.en: Keep one for the Equalizer or Jupiter and for Nothing Gained; any extra sells for 11,000.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个做制裁者或木星，并交“不入虎穴”；多的卖 11000。

use.en: Used for crafting the Equalizer or Jupiter at Gunsmith level 3, with 3 Magnetic Accelerators and 3 Complex Gun Parts. Trophy Display phase 4 wants 3.
use.zh: 武器工作台 3 级配合 3 个磁力加速器、3 个复杂枪械零件，可造制裁者或木星。展示架第 4 阶段要 3 个。

obtain.en: The Queen guards a Harvester, and only while that map condition is on; it shows up on Dam Battlegrounds, The Spaceport and The Blue Gate. Shoot off her leg armor segments: they drop containers, often with a reactor, before she dies. You can also skip her and do the Harvester puzzle.
obtain.zh: 女王只在“收割者”地图条件开启时守着收割者，出现在大坝战场、太空港和蓝门。打掉腿部装甲会掉容器，常带反应堆。也可绕开她只解谜。

tips.en: Aim at her Core and leg joints. Her laser can electrocute everyone looting the Harvester.
tips.zh: 瞄核心和腿关节。她的激光会电到所有在搜收割者的人。

verdict.en: Pure sell-or-recycle part: nothing needs it, but 3,000 coins is a real payout.
verdict.zh: 纯卖或拆：没有任何用途，但 3000 的价格相当可观。

obtain.en: Found on Stella Montis by scavenging, mostly inside buildings. The Lobby building is a reliable spot: look on shelves, in loot piles and small corner rooms.
obtain.zh: 在星辰山搜刮获得，多在建筑内。大厅建筑比较稳：看货架、散落物堆和角落小房间。

tips.en: Selling beats recycling: 2 Sensors and 2 Speaker Components are worth less than 3,000.
tips.zh: 卖比拆划算：2 个传感器加 2 个扬声器零件不值 3000。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for Explosives Station level 3 plus 4 for quests; then Trophy Display wants 8 more.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个升爆炸物工作台 3 级，再留 4 个交任务；展示架还要 8 个。

use.en: Needed for the Wolfpack grenade launcher recipe too. Beyond those needs it sells for 3,000.
use.zh: 狼群的配方也用到它。用不完的卖 3000。

obtain.en: Kill Rocketeers, usually stationed in high-value areas. On the Dam, Hydroponic Dome Complex is mentioned. Take cover, shoot the unarmored thrusters (two down grounds it) and roll when the laser locks. Couriers may drop it too.
obtain.zh: 击杀火箭手，它们常驻高价值区域。大坝可去水培穹顶综合体。找掩体，打无装甲的推进器（毁两个就坠落），激光锁定时翻滚。ARC运输机也可能掉。

tips.en: Quests Nothing Ventured (3) and Out of the Shadows (1) both want it.
tips.zh: “焉得虎子”要 3 个，“走出阴影”要 1 个。

verdict.en: Junk: sell it for 270 or recycle for plastic and rubber; it weighs 3 and can't be equipped.
verdict.zh: 垃圾：卖 270 或拆成塑料和橡胶；重 3 且无法装备。

obtain.en: The wiki lists knocked-out Raiders as the source: augments lose 30% durability per knockout, so one is ruined after four.
obtain.zh: 维基列出的来源是被击倒的奇袭者：强化每次被击倒损失 30% 耐久，四次后损毁。

tips.en: Weight 3 for 270 coins is poor; only carry it if you have the space.
tips.zh: 重 3 只值 270，背包有空位再带。

verdict.en: Recycle for 8 Metal Parts at the workshop, or sell for 640 if you're swimming in metal.
verdict.zh: 回基地拆 8 个金属零件，金属够了就卖 640。

obtain.en: Scavenged from old ARC husks. The Baron Husk's loot pool includes it; those wrecks must be breached and are trapped.
obtain.zh: 从旧 ARC 残骸中搜到。“男爵”残骸的战利品里有，需要破拆且有陷阱。

tips.en: Salvaging in a raid gives 3 Metal Parts versus 8 at the workshop, so carry it back.
tips.zh: 局内拆解只有 3 个金属零件，工作台是 8 个，带回去再拆。

verdict.en: Keep 4 for Gunsmith level 3 and 1 for Wires Crossed; extras sell for 2,000.
verdict.zh: 留 4 个升武器工作台 3 级、1 个给“线路交错”，多的卖 2000。

obtain.en: Sentinels sit in elevated overwatch spots, mostly under Hurricane conditions: north and south of the Breach on the Dam, Town Hall bell tower in Buried City, Spaceport South Trench Tower, Blue Gate Outer Gates beams, Stella Montis Atrium ceiling. Couriers can drop it too.
obtain.zh: 哨卫驻守高处，多在飓风天气：大坝裂口南北、掩埋废城市政厅钟楼、太空港南壕沟塔、蓝门外门横梁、星辰山中庭天花板。ARC运输机也可能掉。

tips.en: It has 300 health and reacts slowly; shoot the yellow canister on its swivel arm for extra damage.
tips.zh: 它只有 300 血且反应慢；打转臂上的黄色罐体伤害更高。

verdict.en: Keep a few for Trophy Display and the Dolabra; surplus sells for 2,000.
verdict.zh: 留几个给战利品展示架和錾斧，多的卖 2000。

obtain.en: Stella Montis is the best bet, though the wiki says Shredders no longer stay there exclusively. Guides point to the main lobby ground floor and the Robotic Sandbox, where 2 to 4 may roam. Shoot the blue thrusters, ideally with a Hullcracker.
obtain.zh: 星辰山最稳，但维基称粉碎者已不限于此。攻略推荐主大厅一层和机器人沙盘，常有 2-4 只。打蓝色推进器，最好用裂甲者。

tips.en: Trophy Display phase 3 wants 5 and the Dolabra recipe uses 3. Extract once you carry a few, because dying loses them.
tips.zh: 展示架第 3 阶段要 5 个，錾斧配方用 3 个。带够几个就撤离，死了会丢。

verdict.en: A new 2.0 Skulker part with no known use yet: hold or sell it for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增的潜伏者零件，暂无已知用途：留着或卖 1000。

obtain.en: The in-game description says it drops from the Meerkat. Skulkers roam Pendola Pass around Almatera Station, but no source confirms the Driver's drop rate.
obtain.zh: 游戏内描述称掉自“潜伏者”。潜伏者在彭多拉山口阿尔玛特拉站一带活动，但没有来源确认引擎的掉率。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for Research Station level 2 and 1 for Tracks of the Beast; also useful as a small turret.
verdict.zh: 留 5 个升研究站 2 级，再留 1 个交“巨兽踪迹”；也能当小炮台。

use.en: It deploys as a turret hitting ARC and raiders within 25 m for 9 damage a shot. Weak, but fine as a distraction.
use.zh: 部署后为炮台，25 米内对 ARC 和奇袭者每发 9 点伤害。偏弱，但可以分散注意力。

obtain.en: Destroy Skulkers on Pendola Pass, around Almatera Station and the snowfields, then loot the wreck. Shoot the thrusters to slow it, then hit the turret once exposed. Couriers can drop it too.
obtain.zh: 在彭多拉山口阿尔玛特拉站和雪原击毁潜伏者并搜刮。先打推进器减速，炮台露出后再打。ARC运输机也可能掉。

tips.en: The Canto Blueprint at Research Station 2 also asks for 10, so don't recycle yet.
tips.zh: 研究站 2 级的颂歌蓝图还要 10 个，先别拆。

verdict.en: Keep 6 for Utility Station level 2 and 1 for Wires Crossed; extras sell for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 留 6 个升工具工作台 2 级、1 个给“线路交错”，多的卖 1000。

use.en: Thrown, it calls ARC onto a target; during the Erratic Wasp event it was used to summon Wasps.
use.zh: 投出后可召 ARC 攻击目标；故障黄蜂活动时有人用它引黄蜂。

obtain.en: Kill Snitches before they finish calling reinforcements. Medium or heavy ammo takes one down in a few shots; knocking out thrusters makes them crash. Hide in foliage to dodge the scanner.
obtain.zh: 在告密者叫来援军之前击杀。中、重型弹药几发即可；打掉推进器会坠毁。躲进植被避开扫描。

tips.en: Only Utility Station level 2 and Wires Crossed need it, so everything else can be sold.
tips.zh: 只有工具工作台 2 级和“线路交错”需要，其余都可以卖。

verdict.en: Keep 2 for quests and 10 only if you're doing Trophy Display; otherwise sell for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 留 2 个交任务，做战利品展示架才留 10 个，其余卖 1000。

obtain.en: Spotters are small 80 HP drones that accompany Bombardiers; shoot the thrusters. They respawn, so don't waste ammo repeatedly. Couriers drop it too.
obtain.zh: 侦察员是伴随投弹手的 80 血小型无人机，打推进器。会重生，别反复浪费弹药。ARC运输机也可能掉。

tips.en: Ruins and Reverberations and Combat Recon each take one.
tips.zh: “废墟和回响”与“战斗侦察”各要 1 个。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for Medical Lab level 3 and 2 for quests; Trophy Display phase 1 wants 5 more.
verdict.zh: 留 5 个升医疗实验室 3 级、2 个交任务；展示架第 1 阶段还要 5 个。

obtain.en: Surveyors flee on sensing a threat, so hit them while transmitting. Stun with a Hornet Driver, then use heavy fuze grenades; heavy ammo strips the armor plates. Couriers during Electromagnetic Storm on the Dam (Scrapyard, Old Battleground) were reported as an easier source.
obtain.zh: 勘测师察觉威胁就逃，趁它传输时下手。先用“马蜂”引擎眩晕，再用重型引信手雷；重型弹药能打掉装甲板。大坝电磁风暴期间的ARC运输机据称更好刷。

tips.en: Don't recycle until Medical Lab L3 and both quests are done.
tips.zh: 医疗实验室 3 级和两个任务完成前别拆。

verdict.en: Recycle at the workshop for 12 Fabric, or sell for 640. Nothing needs it directly.
verdict.zh: 回基地拆 12 个布料，或卖 640。没有直接用途。

obtain.en: Scavenged from old ARC husks; Baron Husk wrecks list it (2 or more). They must be breached and are trapped.
obtain.zh: 从旧 ARC 残骸搜到；“男爵”残骸会出（2 个以上），需要破拆且有陷阱。

tips.en: Salvaging in a raid only returns 5 Fabric.
tips.zh: 局内拆解只返还 5 个布料。

verdict.en: Keep 8 for Medical Lab level 2 plus 15 for Trophy Display phase 1; extras sell for 640.
verdict.zh: 留 8 个升医疗实验室 2 级，展示架第 1 阶段要 15 个，多的卖 640。

obtain.en: Ticks live indoors, clinging to walls and ceilings and often dormant in rafters. Listen for a metallic clank. One Raider Tool hit kills them. Hold interact to pull one off you.
obtain.zh: 跳蚤在室内，趴在墙和天花板上，常在椽梁上休眠。留意金属摩擦声。近战一下即死；被扒上时按住互动甩掉。

tips.en: Vita Spray also uses one; recycling gives ARC Alloy and Chemicals.
tips.zh: 补水喷雾也用 1 个；拆解得ARC合金和化学品。

verdict.en: Keep it for the Powered Descender; surplus sells for a hefty 5,000.
verdict.zh: 留给动力下降器；多的能卖 5000。

obtain.en: Destroy an ARC Turbine; it drifts in mid-raid, with guides saying around 15 minutes left. Hit the spinning yellow tanks once it lands, or use a Jupiter from 150 to 200 m. Sources conflict on the map (Riven Tides vs Rust Belt).
obtain.zh: 击毁 ARC涡轮；它在对局中段出现，攻略说约剩 15 分钟。落地后打黄色旋转罐体，或用木星从 150-200 米外射击。地图说法不一（裂潮镇或锈带）。

tips.en: The wiki says Couriers stopped dropping Turbine parts in patch 1.36, so Turbines are the source.
tips.zh: 维基称 1.36 后ARC运输机不再掉涡轮零件，要靠击毁涡轮。

verdict.en: Keep 8 for Gunsmith level 2, then Trophy Display wants 20; surplus is only worth 640.
verdict.zh: 留 8 个升武器工作台 2 级，展示架再要 20 个；多的只值 640。

obtain.en: Wasps patrol large outdoor areas with Hornets and Fireflies. Knock out several thrusters so it crashes. A Lure Grenade helps escape a swarm. Couriers can drop it too.
obtain.zh: 黄蜂在开阔室外巡逻，常与马蜂和萤火虫同行。打掉多个推进器使其坠毁。诱捕手雷可摆脱蜂群。ARC运输机也可能掉。

tips.en: Recycling gives just 2 ARC Alloy, so selling at 640 is no worse.
tips.zh: 拆解只有 2 个ARC合金，卖 640 也不亏。

verdict.en: Nothing needs it: recycle it for a Processor and plastic, or just sell it for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 没有任何用途：拆成处理器和塑料，或直接卖 1000。

obtain.en: Residential loot only; no guide names a specific spot. The Residential areas with the most containers are Old Town (77) and Researcher Lodgings (37) on Pendola Pass, Hotel Panorama Azzurro (40) on Riven Tides and the Village (33) on The Blue Gate.
obtain.zh: 只出在住宅类物资里，没有攻略点名具体位置。住宅容器最多的区域：彭多拉山口的老城区（约77个）和研究员住所区（约37个），裂潮镇的蔚蓝全景酒店（约40个），蓝门的村庄（约33个）。

tips.en: Recycling gives 6 Plastic Parts and 1 Processor, while salvaging in a raid gives only the Processor. Recycle at the workshop if you want both.
tips.zh: 工作台回收可得 6 个塑料零件和 1 个处理器，局内拆解只有处理器。两样都要就回基地回收。

verdict.en: Keep one for the quest The League, then recycle the rest for Metal Parts.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个给任务“球队”，其余回收换金属零件。

obtain.en: Guaranteed spot on Dam Battlegrounds: at the goalposts east of the Water Towers (southwest of the Electrical Substation), turn north and loot the bicycle leaning on the tower. Another guide names a bicycle beside a hut near the train station on Buried City. Otherwise it is random Residential loot.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场有固定点：水塔东侧（变电站西南）的球门处往北，搜靠在塔边的自行车。另有攻略说掩埋废城火车站附近小屋旁的自行车上也有。除此之外是住宅类随机物资。

tips.en: Recycling returns 4 Canisters and 10 Metal Parts, far more than the 3 Canisters you get from salvaging in raid.
tips.zh: 回收可得 4 个小罐和 10 个金属零件，比局内拆解的 3 个小罐划算得多。

verdict.en: Pure salvage: no quest or upgrade needs it, so recycle it for Batteries or sell.
verdict.zh: 纯杂物：没有任务或升级需要，回收拿电池或直接卖。

obtain.en: Security loot. Only a handful of areas carry that tag: Security Wing (26 container spots in an ordinary round) and Reinforced Reception (12) on The Blue Gate, the Launch Towers (16) on The Spaceport, and the Hydroponic Dome Complex (15) and Control Tower (7) on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 安保类物资。带这个标签的区域不多：蓝门的安保区辅楼（普通对局约26个容器点）和加固前台（约12个），太空港的发射塔（约16个），大坝战场的水培穹顶综合体（约15个）和控制塔（约7个）。

tips.en: Recycling gives 2 Batteries and 6 Metal Parts; salvaging in raid gives 7 Metal Parts and no Batteries. Pick by what you are short of.
tips.zh: 回收得 2 个电池和 6 个金属零件，局内拆解只有 7 个金属零件。缺什么就选哪种。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell it for 2,000 coins, or recycle for 4 Processors.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 2000 钱币，或拆成 4 个处理器。

use.en: No live project, quest or workshop upgrade asks for it. It is worth 2,000 coins, or 4 Processors if you recycle it.
use.zh: 没有进行中的项目、任务或工作台升级需要它。值 2000 钱币，拆解可得 4 个处理器。

obtain.en: Exodus loot. Exodus-tagged areas are the Stacking Yard (55 container spots) and Port Authority Building (29) on Riven Tides, the Observatory (28) and Deep-Space Telescope (17) on Pendola Pass, and Rocket Assembly on The Spaceport. Some guides also suggest the Hydroponic Dome Complex on Dam, which is unconfirmed.
obtain.zh: 离巢类物资。带此标签的区域有裂潮镇的堆料场（约55个容器点）和港务局大楼（约29个）、彭多拉山口的天文台（约28个）和深空望远镜（约17个），以及太空港的火箭组装区。有攻略也推荐大坝的水培穹顶综合体，但未证实。

tips.en: Recycling yields 4 Processors, twice what in-raid salvaging gives. It weighs 3, so only carry it out if you will use it.
tips.zh: 回收可得 4 个处理器，是局内拆解的两倍。重量 3，不打算用就别带出来。

verdict.en: No upgrade or quest uses it: recycle for Sensors and Wires, or sell it for 2,000.
verdict.zh: 没有升级或任务用得上：回收拿传感器和导线，或卖 2000。

obtain.en: Security loot; no guide names a container. The richest Security area is Security Wing on The Blue Gate (26 container spots in an ordinary round), so pair it with Reinforced Reception next door.
obtain.zh: 安保类物资，没有攻略点名容器。安保类最多的是蓝门的安保区辅楼（普通对局约26个容器点），顺路把旁边的加固前台一起搜。

tips.en: Recycling returns 3 Sensors and 2 Wires; salvaging in raid gives just 2 Sensors, so recycle at the workshop.
tips.zh: 回收得 3 个传感器和 2 个导线，局内拆解只有 2 个传感器，回基地回收更好。

verdict.en: Junk: nothing needs it, so recycle it for Batteries or sell it.
verdict.zh: 杂物：没有用途，回收拿电池或直接卖。

obtain.en: Security loot. On The Spaceport that means the Launch Towers; on Dam Battlegrounds, the Hydroponic Dome Complex and Control Tower; on The Blue Gate, Security Wing and Reinforced Reception.
obtain.zh: 安保类物资。在太空港就是发射塔；大坝战场是水培穹顶综合体和控制塔；蓝门是安保区辅楼和加固前台。

tips.en: Recycling also returns 2 Wires on top of the 2 Batteries that in-raid salvaging gives.
tips.zh: 回收除了 2 个电池，还多给 2 个导线，局内拆解则只有电池。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it; keep 1 only if you craft the Advanced Camera, and sell or recycle the rest.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求；只有要做“高级相机”才留 1 个，其余卖掉或回收。

use.en: Only the Advanced Camera recipe uses 1. Anything beyond that is 8 Plastic Parts of recycling, or a 640-coin sale.
use.zh: 只有“高级相机”配方要 1 个。除此之外可回收 8 个塑料零件，或卖 640 钱币。

obtain.en: Security loot, typically offices and guard rooms. Security-tagged areas: the Launch Towers on The Spaceport, Security Wing and Reinforced Reception on The Blue Gate, and the Control Tower and Hydroponic Dome Complex on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 安保类物资，常见于办公室和警卫室。带安保标签的区域：太空港的发射塔，蓝门的安保区辅楼和加固前台，大坝战场的控制塔和水培穹顶综合体。

tips.en: It weighs under 1 and stacks to 5, so carrying a few costs almost nothing.
tips.zh: 重量不到 1，可叠 5 个，多带几个几乎没负担。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell it for 640 coins, or recycle for 8 Metal Parts.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 640 钱币，或回收 8 个金属零件。

obtain.en: Residential loot containers. On Dam Battlegrounds try Pale Apartments and Ruby Residence; on Buried City try Plaza Rosa and Grandioso Apartments.
obtain.zh: 住宅类战利品容器。大坝战场去苍白公寓、红宝石宅邸；掩埋废城去玫瑰广场、奢华公寓。

tips.en: Recycling gives 8 Metal Parts, double what in-raid salvaging gives, so bring spares home.
tips.zh: 回收得 8 个金属零件，是局内拆解的两倍，多余的带回基地回收。

verdict.en: Nothing needs it: recycle for Chemicals and Oil, or sell for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 没有任何需求：回收拿化学品和油，或卖 1000。

obtain.en: Mechanical loot; no guide names a spot. The biggest Mechanical areas are the Railyard on Pendola Pass (49 container spots in an ordinary round), Maintenance Wing (34) and Adorned Wreckage (21) on The Blue Gate, and the Controlled Access Zone (22) on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 机械类物资，没有攻略点名位置。机械类最大的区域：彭多拉山口的铁路站场（普通对局约49个容器点），蓝门的维护区辅楼（约34个）和庄严残骸（约21个），大坝战场的受控访问区（约22个）。

tips.en: Recycling returns 5 Chemicals and 2 Oil; salvaging in raid only gives the Oil.
tips.zh: 回收得 5 个化学品和 2 个油，局内拆解只有油。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 1,000 coins, or recycle for 6 Chemicals and 2 Steel Springs.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 1000 钱币，或回收出 6 个化学品和 2 个钢质弹簧。

obtain.en: Industrial loot: car hoods, buses, generators, metal crates, industrial drawers and red lockers. One guide lists the Hydroponic Dome Complex, Power Generation Complex and Water Treatment Control on Dam; Container Storage, Rocket Assembly, Shipping Warehouse and Vehicle Maintenance on The Spaceport; Adorned Wreckage on The Blue Gate; and the Loading Bay on Stella Montis.
obtain.zh: 工业类物资：车引擎盖、巴士、发电机、金属箱、工业抽屉和红色储物柜。有攻略列出大坝的水培穹顶综合体、发电厂综合体、水处理控制中心；太空港的集装箱仓库、火箭组装区、货运仓库和载具维护区；蓝门的庄严残骸；星辰山的装卸区。

tips.en: The container list is mostly vehicles and garages, so check wrecks and depots on your route instead of making a special trip.
tips.zh: 容器多为车辆和车库，顺路翻残骸和仓库就行，不必专程去。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 2,000 coins, or recycle for 14 Plastic Parts and 4 Wires.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 2000 钱币，或回收出 14 个塑料零件和 4 个导线。

obtain.en: Search the old computer terminals with data reels in the Space Travel building on Buried City: guides point to level 3 (southwest corner), level 4 (behind the elevator) and level 6 (behind the elevators and southwest of the breach door). Server racks and breachable terminals there are the backup; the tops of the Spaceport's Launch Towers also work.
obtain.zh: 去掩埋废城航天大楼搜带数据卷盘的老式电脑终端：攻略指向3层西南角、4层电梯后，以及6层电梯后和破拆门西南的房间。找不到再搜那里的服务器机柜和可破拆终端；太空港发射塔顶部也能出。

tips.en: Recycling gives 14 Plastic Parts and 4 Wires, much better than the 4 Wires from salvaging in raid.
tips.zh: 回收得 14 个塑料零件和 4 个导线，比局内拆解只有 4 个导线强很多。

verdict.en: Keep 2 for Medical Lab level 2, then recycle the rest.
verdict.zh: 留 2 个给医疗实验室 2 级，其余回收。

obtain.en: Medical loot. Guides point first to the Hospital on Buried City, with the Testing Annex on Dam Battlegrounds as the quieter option; blue drawers and white cabinets are the containers to check. The Commissary Supermarket on Pendola Pass is the largest Medical area (36 container spots in an ordinary round).
obtain.zh: 医疗类物资。攻略首推掩埋废城的医院，大坝战场的测试附楼人少一些；重点搜蓝色抽屉和白色柜子。彭多拉山口的军需超市是最大的医疗类区域（普通对局约36个容器点）。

tips.en: The Medical Lab 2 upgrade also wants Tick Pods and Durable Cloth, so start collecting those alongside.
tips.zh: 医疗实验室 2 级还需要“跳蚤”收纳舱和耐磨布料，可以一并攒起来。

tips.en: Recycling gives 3 Batteries and 3 Rubber Parts, better than the 2 Batteries from in-raid salvage.
tips.zh: 回收得 3 个电池和 3 个橡胶零件，比局内拆解的 2 个电池好。

verdict.en: Low-value trash: recycle it for 4 Plastic Parts, or leave it if your bag is full.
verdict.zh: 低价值垃圾：回收得 4 个塑料零件，背包满了就别捡。

obtain.en: Residential loot that turns up in any home. If you want plastic, Old Town on Pendola Pass has the most Residential containers (77 in an ordinary round).
obtain.zh: 住宅类物资，任何民居都可能有。想要塑料的话，彭多拉山口的老城区住宅容器最多（普通对局约77个）。

tips.en: At 270 coins it is not worth a bag slot unless you need plastic.
tips.zh: 只值 270，除非缺塑料，否则不值得占格子。

verdict.en: Keep 1 for the quest The League, then recycle for rubber and fabric.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个给任务“球队”，其余回收换橡胶和布料。

obtain.en: Guaranteed spot on Dam Battlegrounds: from the goalposts east of the Water Towers, turn west and loot the metal container on the ground next to a metal wall. Destructoid also found one in Ruby Residence; otherwise it is random Residential loot.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场有固定点：从水塔东侧的球门往西，搜金属墙边地上的金属箱。另有攻略在红宝石宅邸搜到过；此外就是住宅类随机物资。

tips.en: Recycling returns 9 Fabric and 9 Rubber Parts, a lot for a 0.8 weight item.
tips.zh: 回收可得 9 个布料和 9 个橡胶零件，重量仅 0.8，很划算。

verdict.en: New in 2.0: keep 3 for the Research Station level 3 upgrade, then recycle.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增：留 3 个给研究站 3 级，之后回收。

obtain.en: New in 2.0; a search a week after launch found no guide or wiki entry naming where it spawns. Its recycle output (Speaker Component, Wires) suggests electronics loot, but that is a guess.
obtain.zh: 2.0新增；上线一周后搜索仍没有攻略或维基写明刷新位置。从回收产物（扬声器零件、导线）看可能属于电子类物资，但这只是推测。

tips.en: The same Research Station upgrade also takes Exodus Technical Handbooks and Bully Fragmenters, so check you can get those before hoarding.
tips.zh: 研究站该升级还需要“离巢”技术手册和“恶霸”破片弹，囤之前先确认能凑齐。

verdict.en: No use beyond salvage: recycle for 12 Rubber Parts or sell.
verdict.zh: 除了回收没别的用：回收得 12 个橡胶零件，或直接卖。

obtain.en: Residential loot with no named container. Hotel Panorama Azzurro on Riven Tides is a big Residential stop (40 container spots in an ordinary round) if you are already on that map.
obtain.zh: 住宅类物资，没有点名的容器。人在裂潮镇的话，蔚蓝全景酒店是个大的住宅点（普通对局约40个容器点）。

tips.en: Recycling gives 12 Rubber Parts versus 5 from salvaging in raid.
tips.zh: 回收可得 12 个橡胶零件，局内拆解只有 5 个。

verdict.en: Keep one: it is the Scrappy level 2 upgrade item. Recycle the rest for Fabric.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个：废品仔 2 级升级要用。多余的回收拿布料。

obtain.en: Residential loot. Guides most often cite Grandioso Apartments on Buried City, then Santa Maria Houses and the Red Tower; on The Blue Gate, the Village, Raider's Refuge and Ruined Homestead. Reports from Dam Battlegrounds conflict.
obtain.zh: 住宅类物资。攻略最常推荐掩埋废城的奢华公寓，其次是圣玛丽亚住宅区和红塔；蓝门则是村庄、奇袭者避难所和废弃农庄。大坝战场的说法互相矛盾。

tips.en: If you already upgraded Scrappy, treat it as plain junk: 8 Fabric and 1 Metal Parts on recycling.
tips.zh: 废品仔已升级的话就当杂物，回收得 8 个布料和 1 个金属零件。

verdict.en: Hold 3 until you have checked your Outpost upgrade: two guides say leveling the Outpost needs them. Otherwise recycle for Chemicals or sell for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 先留3个，确认哨站升级要不要：两份攻略说升级哨站需要它。用不上再回收拿化学品或卖1000。

obtain.en: Pendola Pass loot. One guide found them at the Railyard: inside the trains at the Freight Terminal and on tables and in desk drawers in the Controlled Receiving Facility; Storm Huts can hold them once Flash Freeze opens the huts. Another found two in Observatory lockers.
obtain.zh: 彭多拉山口的物资。有攻略在铁路站场找到：货运站的列车里，以及受控收货设施的桌面和书桌抽屉；极寒冰爆开启风暴小屋后屋里也可能有。另一份在天文台的储物柜里找到两个。

tips.en: It stacks to 5 and weighs 0.5, so it is easy to carry a few home for recycling.
tips.zh: 可叠 5 个、重量 0.5，带几个回家回收很轻松。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Trophy Display project, then recycle for rubber and fabric.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个给“战利品展示架”项目，之后回收换橡胶和布料。

obtain.en: Medical loot. Guides rate the Testing Annex on Dam Battlegrounds the most consistent: go up the main staircase, turn left and loot the medical containers along the upper-floor corridor. The Hospital on Buried City and Medical Research on Stella Montis (white drawers) are the alternatives. Expect 2 to 4 runs for 3.
obtain.zh: 医疗类物资。攻略认为大坝战场的测试附楼最稳：上主楼梯左转，搜上层走廊沿线的医疗容器。备选是掩埋废城的医院和星辰山医学研究部的白色抽屉。凑齐3个约需跑2到4局。

tips.en: It is a phase 2 item, so you can ignore it until you reach that stage.
tips.zh: 这是第 2 阶段的材料，没做到那一步前可以先不管。

verdict.en: Keep 1 for Snap and Salvage; otherwise it is a good 3,000-coin sale.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个给“拍照并拆解回收”，否则卖 3000 很划算。

obtain.en: The wiki lists scavenging on Stella Montis, and it is tagged Exodus. No specific room or container is named.
obtain.zh: 社区维基列为星辰山搜刮，并带出走标签，未指明房间或容器。

tips.en: Recycling gives one Advanced Mechanical Component and one Sensor, so only recycle if you need those parts.
tips.zh: 回收得 1 个高级机械元件和 1 个传感器，缺这些零件时再回收。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 3,000 coins each.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：每个卖 3000 钱币。

obtain.en: Scavenged on Stella Montis according to the wiki, and tagged Exodus. No exact container is given.
obtain.zh: 社区维基称在星辰山搜刮，并带出走标签，未给具体容器。

tips.en: It sells for far more than its parts: recycling only gives an Advanced Electrical Component and a Speaker Component.
tips.zh: 卖价远高于拆解所得：回收只有高级电子元件和扬声器零件各 1 个。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Utility Station level 3 upgrade; after that, recycling or selling at 2000 coins are both fine.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个升级工具工作台 3 级，之后可回收，也可按 2000 钱币出售。

obtain.en: It comes out of tech containers: Server Racks and Recording Panels. Stella Montis Assembly Workshops is the most cited farm; Research and Administration on Dam Battlegrounds and the Space Travel building in Buried City also work. Spaceport is dense with tech zones.
obtain.zh: 出自科技类容器：服务器机架和录音面板。最常被推荐的刷点是星辰山的组装厂车间；大坝战场的研究与行政楼、掩埋废城的航天大楼也行，太空港的科技区域很密。

tips.en: Expect roughly one per raid. Entering with an empty loadout lets you secure it in your safe pocket and leave early.
tips.zh: 通常一局约一个。空装备入场，放进安全口袋后即可提前撤离。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 640 coins, or recycle for 8 Metal Parts.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 640 钱币，或回收 8 个金属零件。

obtain.en: Residential loot only, with no fixed spot. Buried City has the most residential areas; Grandioso Apartments there, Ruby Residence and Pale Apartments on Dam Battlegrounds, and the Village on The Blue Gate are named. Popular buildings get looted early.
obtain.zh: 只在居住区刷新，没有固定点。掩埋废城居住区最多，奢华公寓是常提的点；大坝战场的红宝石宅邸、苍白公寓和蓝门的村庄也可去。热门建筑常被早早搜空。

tips.en: It weighs 2, so leave it behind unless you have spare room; recycling at home gives 8 Metal Parts, double the in-raid yield.
tips.zh: 重量 2，背包有空位再拿；回基地回收得 8 个金属零件，是局内拆解的两倍。

verdict.en: Nothing needs it, so the choice is 1000 coins from a trader or 12 Metal Parts from recycling.
verdict.zh: 没有任何升级或任务需要它，卖 1000 钱币或回收得 12 个金属零件，二选一。

obtain.en: Residential and Commercial clutter in kitchens, shops and shelves. Areas that roll both types include Hotel Panorama Azzurro on Riven Tides, the Village on The Blue Gate and Plaza Rosa on Buried City.
obtain.zh: 住宅和商业类杂物，多在厨房、商店和架子上。同时出这两类的区域有裂潮镇的蔚蓝全景酒店、蓝门的村庄和掩埋废城的玫瑰广场。

tips.en: Sell it if you need coins; its sell price is high for a 0.8 weight item. Recycle only when you are short on Metal Parts.
tips.zh: 缺钱币就卖，它重量只有 0.8，卖价相当高；只有缺金属零件时才回收。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for Trophy Display phase 5, then recycle extras for Exodus Modules or sell at 3500.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个给“战利品展示架”第 5 阶段，多余的回收换离巢模块，或卖 3500。

obtain.en: Exodus loot, tied to Stella Montis: the Assembly workshops and server rooms are the usual farm, and Medical Research on the lower level has many containers. Rocket Assembly on The Spaceport is also reported.
obtain.zh: 属于离巢类战利品，主要在星辰山：组装厂车间和服务器室是常规刷点，下层医学研究部容器多。太空港的火箭组装区也有人遇到。

tips.en: Recycle it at home, not in the raid: only the home recycler returns the Exodus Module; salvaging gives 3 Batteries.
tips.zh: 要回家回收：只有回收机才能拿到离巢模块，局内拆解只有 3 个电池。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 1,000 coins, or recycle for 7 Rubber Parts and a Speaker Component.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 1000 钱币，或回收出 7 个橡胶零件和 1 个扬声器零件。

obtain.en: General residential and commercial loot with no fixed spawn. Buried City is the usual pick because of its many residential containers. If you only need two, extract as soon as you have them.
obtain.zh: 居住区和商业区的普通战利品，没有固定刷新点。掩埋废城居住区容器多，最常被推荐。只需 2 个，拿到就撤。

tips.en: Recycling at home gives 7 Rubber Parts plus a Speaker Component; in-raid salvaging gives only the Speaker Component.
tips.zh: 回基地回收可得 7 个橡胶零件和 1 个扬声器零件；局内拆解只有扬声器零件。

verdict.en: Recycle it for 11 Chemicals; no upgrade needs it, and the 640 coin sale is poor value.
verdict.zh: 直接回收得 11 个化学品；没有升级需要它，卖 640 钱币不划算。

obtain.en: Residential areas only, mostly under sinks and on shelves in apartments. Researcher Lodgings on Pendola Pass (37 container spots in an ordinary round) and Santa Maria Houses on Buried City (19) are compact places to sweep.
obtain.zh: 只在住宅区，多在公寓水槽下和架子上。彭多拉山口的研究员住所区（普通对局约37个容器点）和掩埋废城的圣玛丽亚住宅区（约19个）都适合集中搜。

tips.en: Only recycle when you actually need Chemicals; otherwise sell it and skip the weight.
tips.zh: 缺化学品时才回收，否则卖掉省负重。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 1,000 coins, or recycle for 2 Canisters and 2 Wires.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 1000 钱币，或回收出 2 个小罐和 2 个导线。

obtain.en: Guaranteed in the Red Tower lockers in Buried City, northeast of Plaza Rosa. Other Buried City options are Grandioso Apartments and the hospital cabinets; on Dam Battlegrounds try Pale Apartments, Ruby Residence and Pattern House.
obtain.zh: 掩埋废城玫瑰广场东北的红塔储物柜必出。掩埋废城还可去奢华公寓和医院柜子；大坝战场可去苍白公寓、红宝石宅邸和图案之家。

tips.en: It weighs 2 and is worth only a modest 1,000, so grab it only when there is room.
tips.zh: 重量 2，只值 1000，背包有空位再拿。

verdict.en: Plain junk: 640 coins or 7 Metal Parts, and nothing in the workshop needs it.
verdict.zh: 普通杂物：卖 640 钱币或回收 7 个金属零件，工坊不需要它。

obtain.en: Commercial areas only, so shops and food counters. The largest Commercial areas are the Commissary Supermarket on Pendola Pass (36 container spots in an ordinary round), Research & Administration on Dam Battlegrounds (36) and Piazza Arbusto on Buried City (33).
obtain.zh: 只在商业区，也就是商店和餐饮柜台。商业类最大的区域：彭多拉山口的军需超市（普通对局约36个容器点）、大坝战场的研究与行政区（约36个）和掩埋废城的阿布斯托广场（约33个）。

tips.en: Recycle only when short on Metal Parts; the sell price is similar to other 640 coin junk.
tips.zh: 缺金属零件才回收，卖价和其他 640 钱币的杂物差不多。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for Gear Bench level 3 and 3 more for Taking Stock; spares recycle or sell.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个升级装备工作台 3 级，“清点物资”再要 3 个；多余的回收或卖掉。

obtain.en: Dam Battlegrounds is best: Hydroponic Dome Complex lockers and shelves, and the Power Generation Complex. Industrial zones on Spaceport, The Blue Gate and Stella Montis also drop it, in rusty containers and red lockers.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场最好：水培穹顶综合体的储物柜和货架，以及发电厂综合体。太空港、蓝门和星辰山的工业区也会掉，在生锈容器和红色储物柜里。

tips.en: Surplus recycles into 7 Chemicals and 2 Batteries, so it is better to recycle than to salvage in the raid.
tips.zh: 多余的回收可得 7 个化学品和 2 个电池，比局内拆解划算。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 1,000 coins, or recycle for a Voltage Converter and 5 Metal Parts.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 1000 钱币，或回收出 1 个变电器和 5 个金属零件。

obtain.en: Industrial and Electrical zones: toolboxes, lockers and power cases. Research and Administration, the Power Generation Complex and Loading Bay are the recommended Dam and Stella spots; Spaceport is another suggestion.
obtain.zh: 工业和电气区域：工具箱、储物柜和电源箱。推荐大坝战场的研究与行政楼、发电厂综合体，以及星辰山的装卸区；太空港也有人推荐。

tips.en: Recycling at home beats salvaging in a raid, which gives only the Voltage Converter, but the 1,000 sale is usually simpler.
tips.zh: 回基地回收比局内拆解（只有变电器）多得金属零件，但直接卖 1000 通常更省事。

verdict.en: No workshop or quest uses it, so recycle for 2 Magnets and 4 Metal Parts, or sell at 1000.
verdict.zh: 没有升级或任务需要，回收得 2 个磁铁和 4 个金属零件，或卖 1000。

obtain.en: Industrial points of interest: Research and Administration, Loading Bay and Power Generation Complex on Dam Battlegrounds, Loading Bay on Stella Montis, and the Shipping Warehouse at Spaceport.
obtain.zh: 工业类地点：大坝战场的研究与行政楼、装卸区、发电厂综合体，星辰山的装卸区，以及太空港的货运仓库。

verdict.en: A new 2.0 Pendola Pass item that sells for 3000; recycling only gives 2 Durable Cloth.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增、彭多拉山口的物品，卖 3000；回收只得 2 个耐磨布料。

obtain.en: Reported only on Pendola Pass, in any container but rarely: the Storm Hut market shelves, Railyard, Almatera Station and the Commissary Supermarket. The Observatory is busy. The Outpost's Room 4 reportedly needs three.
obtain.zh: 据报道只在彭多拉山口，任何容器都可能出但很少：风暴小屋的商铺货架、铁路站场、阿尔马特拉车站和商品超市。天文台人多。据称前哨站第 4 间房需要 3 个。

tips.en: Sell price beats recycling by a lot, but the Outpost room needs may change; check the upgrade screen before selling.
tips.zh: 卖价远高于回收，但前哨站需求可能变，卖之前先看升级界面。

verdict.en: Keep 1 for With a View; spares are worth 6,000 coins each.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个给“风景如画”，多余的每个值 6000 钱币。

obtain.en: Exodus loot from Stella Montis. The Assembly area spawns the most, and Geiger Counters and Spectrum Analyzers appear in the same places.
obtain.zh: 离巢类战利品，来自星辰山。组装厂刷新最多，盖革计数器和频谱分析仪也在同一带。

tips.en: It cannot be made by recycling anything, so hold your 1 for the quest before selling spares.
tips.zh: 没有任何回收途径能得到它，先留好任务要的 1 个再卖多余的。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for Explosives Station level 3, then recycle the extras for 16 Chemicals and 3 Crude Explosives.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个升级爆炸物工作台 3 级，多余的回收得 16 个化学品和 3 个粗制炸药。

obtain.en: Medical zones only: cabinets, shelves and crates. The Pharmacy at Plaza Rosa in Buried City is the top pick; Testing Annex back storage on Dam Battlegrounds is calmer than the Hospital.
obtain.zh: 只在医疗区域：柜子、货架和箱子。掩埋废城玫瑰广场的药房最佳；大坝战场测试附楼的后部储藏室比医院安静。

verdict.en: Keep 1 for Snap and Salvage, then sell the rest for 6000; it is also a Line in the Sand reward.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个给“拍照并拆解回收”，其余卖 6000；它也是“沙滩防线”的奖励。

obtain.en: Stella Montis Exodus loot, mostly Assembly and its workshops, though some players report Medical Research. Spawns are random, and shredders patrol the area.
obtain.zh: 星辰山的离巢类战利品，多在组装厂和车间，也有人在医学研究部遇到。刷新随机，附近有碎纸机类敌人巡逻。

tips.en: Recycling gives a Magnetic Accelerator and Steel Spring; check if you need them before taking 6000 coins.
tips.zh: 回收得磁力加速器和钢质弹簧，先看是否需要，再决定是否换 6000 钱币。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 640 coins, or recycle for 8 Metal Parts.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 640 钱币，或回收 8 个金属零件。

obtain.en: Mechanical and Electrical loot, often in car hoods. One guide calls a car near the Power Generation Complex extraction on Dam Battlegrounds a near-guaranteed 2 to 3 brackets; on The Spaceport, check car hoods and the tunnel below the Launch Towers.
obtain.zh: 机械和电气类物资，常在车引擎盖里。有攻略说大坝战场发电厂综合体撤离点附近有辆车，几乎每次都能开出2到3个；太空港就搜车引擎盖和发射塔下方的隧道。

verdict.en: A 3000 coin item; recycle only if you want the Advanced Mechanical Components and Magnets.
verdict.zh: 值 3000 钱币；只有想要高级机械元件和磁铁时才回收。

obtain.en: Exodus loot on Stella Montis, mostly in laboratory, research and medical areas such as Medical Research. No fixed container is documented.
obtain.zh: 星辰山的离巢类战利品，多在实验室、研究和医疗区域，如医学研究部。没有记录固定容器。

tips.en: Nothing in the workshop needs it, so choose coins or crafting parts based on what you are short of.
tips.zh: 工坊不需要它，缺钱币还是缺制作材料，自己决定。

verdict.en: A 3000 coin Stella Montis item; recycling gives Advanced Mechanical Components, which makes it worth keeping for crafting.
verdict.zh: 星辰山 3000 钱币的物品；回收得高级机械元件，适合留着做制作材料。

obtain.en: Rare Exodus item found only on Stella Montis, mainly in lab and research zones. Market median can sit below the 3000 base value.
obtain.zh: 仅在星辰山出现的稀有离巢物品，多在实验和研究区域。市场成交中位价可能低于 3000。

tips.en: Sell it to a trader for the full 3000 if you want coins; the market may pay less.
tips.zh: 想换钱币就卖给商人拿满 3000，玩家市场可能更低。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for Research Station level 1, then sell or recycle the rest.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个升级研究站 1 级，其余出售或回收。

obtain.en: Electrical and Technological loot. Guides suggest Port Authority on Riven Tides, Cielo Sereno Observatory and the Seed Vault industrial areas on Pendola Pass, and the Power Generation Complex on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 电气和科技类战利品。推荐裂潮镇的港务局大楼、彭多拉山口的晴空天文台和种子库工业区，以及大坝战场的发电厂综合体。

tips.en: Pumps are often left lying on open surfaces, so scan desks and shelves before opening containers.
tips.zh: 水泵常放在外面的台面上，先看桌面和货架，别急着开容器。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for Refiner level 3, then recycle spares for Oil and Mechanical Components or sell at 2000.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个升级精加工机 3 级，多余的回收得油和机械元件，或卖 2000。

obtain.en: Mostly from breaching cars and vehicle wrecks. Dam Battlegrounds Water Treatment, the Buried City highway and The Blue Gate checkpoint and tunnel are recommended; the checkpoint is fastest, the highway safer.
obtain.zh: 主要来自撬开汽车和车辆残骸。推荐大坝战场水处理厂、掩埋废城的公路，以及蓝门的检查站和隧道；检查站最快，公路更安全。

tips.en: Three motors fit in one run if you sweep a vehicle-heavy route.
tips.zh: 沿车辆多的路线走，一局就能凑齐 3 个。

verdict.en: Worth 270 coins or 3 Metal Parts, so it is junk; drop it unless your inventory has space.
verdict.zh: 只值 270 钱币或 3 个金属零件，属于垃圾，背包有空位再带。

obtain.en: Mechanical loot, mostly on vehicles and in garages. Mechanical-tagged areas with the most containers are the Railyard on Pendola Pass and Maintenance Wing on The Blue Gate; on Buried City it is the Parking Garage.
obtain.zh: 机械类物资，多在车辆和车库里。机械类容器最多的区域是彭多拉山口的铁路站场和蓝门的维护区辅楼；掩埋废城则是停车场。

verdict.en: Nothing needs it: sell it for 1000 coins, or recycle it only if you are short on Fabric.
verdict.zh: 没有任何升级或任务需要它：直接卖1000钱币，缺布料时再拆解。

obtain.en: Tagged Industrial loot, so check factory-style buildings and workshop containers. The wiki names no fixed spot; it is a random scavenge find.
obtain.zh: 属于工业类战利品，去厂房和车间类建筑的容器里翻。社区没有固定刷新点，纯随机。

tips.en: Recycling gives 6 Fabric and 2 Oil, while salvaging in raid gives only 2 Oil, so wait until you are back at the workshop to break it down.
tips.zh: 拆解得6布料和2油，战局内分解只有2油，回营地再拆更划算。

verdict.en: Keep 1 for Movie Night; any other is a 2,000-coin sell.
verdict.zh: 留 1 台给“电影之夜”，其余卖 2000 钱币。

obtain.en: Residential loot with no fixed spawn. Buried City is the usual pick because of its many apartments (Grandioso Apartments is a popular stop, dressers especially). Stella Montis Cultural Archives crates and Dam Ruby Residence are also suggested.
obtain.zh: 住宅类战利品，没有固定刷新点。掩埋废城公寓多，最常被推荐（奢华公寓、梳妆台）；星辰山文化档案馆的木箱和大坝红宝石宅邸也有人去。

tips.en: Movie Night needs 1, so extract with it in your Safe Pocket to hand it in.
tips.zh: “电影之夜”要 1 台，记得放进安全口袋带出去交。

tips.en: Recycling (2 Battery, 6 Wires) beats salvaging (4 Wires), but sell value is higher if you need coins.
tips.zh: 拆解得2电池6导线，比分解的4导线多；缺钱的话直接卖更值。

verdict.en: Pure salvage: recycle it for Batteries or sell it for 1000; no upgrade or quest asks for it.
verdict.zh: 纯杂物：拆成电池或卖1000钱币，没有升级和任务需要。

obtain.en: Electrical, Residential and Commercial loot. Guides favour Dam Battlegrounds and Buried City, with Dam's Electrical Substation as an Electrical stop. On other maps, Maintenance Wing on The Blue Gate (34 container spots in an ordinary round) and the Customs House on Riven Tides (20) are the big Electrical areas.
obtain.zh: 电气、住宅和商业类物资。攻略偏好大坝战场和掩埋废城，大坝的变电站是电气类点位。其他地图上，蓝门的维护区辅楼（普通对局约34个容器点）和裂潮镇的海关大楼（约20个）是大的电气区。

tips.en: Recycling returns 2 Battery and 2 Wires, salvaging in raid only 2 Battery.
tips.zh: 拆解得2电池和2导线，战局内分解只有2电池。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Gear Bench level 2 upgrade, then recycle or sell the rest.
verdict.zh: 留3根给装备工作台2级升级，多余的拆解或卖掉。

obtain.en: Electrical, Commercial and Residential loot; it cannot be crafted. Guides rate the Spaceport Departure Building (stacked computer rooms) and Dam's Power Generation Complex and Field Depot (drawers, desks, lockers) highly. A Path Not Yours also rewards 2.
obtain.zh: 电气、商业、住宅类战利品，无法制作。太空港候机楼（多层机房）和大坝发电厂综合体、前线仓库（抽屉、桌子、储物柜）评价最高。完成“非你之路”也奖励2根。

tips.en: Gear Bench 2 also wants 5 Electrical Components and 5 Hornet Drivers, so collect those in the same runs.
tips.zh: 装备工作台2级还要5个电子元件和5个“马蜂”引擎，可以同一趟一起凑。

tips.en: Spare cables recycle into 4 Wires, one more than salvaging.
tips.zh: 多余的拆解得4导线，比分解多1个。

verdict.en: No upgrade or quest uses it: recycle for a Processor, or sell for 1000.
verdict.zh: 没有升级或任务需要：拆出处理器，或直接卖1000钱币。

obtain.en: Residential loot only; no named spawn point. Big Residential stops: Old Town on Pendola Pass, Hotel Panorama Azzurro on Riven Tides and the Village on The Blue Gate.
obtain.zh: 只出在住宅类物资里，没有点名的刷新点。大的住宅点：彭多拉山口的老城区、裂潮镇的蔚蓝全景酒店和蓝门的村庄。

tips.en: Recycling gives 1 Processor and 2 Wires; salvaging gives just the Processor. Processors are the useful part.
tips.zh: 拆解得1处理器和2导线，分解只有处理器，处理器才是重点。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 1,000 coins, or recycle for a Sensors and a Speaker Component.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 1000 钱币，或回收出传感器和扬声器零件各 1 个。

obtain.en: Commercial and Residential loot: shops, offices and apartments. Electronics-heavy buildings such as Buried City's Space Travel are suggested for electronics in general.
obtain.zh: 商业和住宅类战利品，商店、办公室、公寓里找。电子设备多的建筑（如掩埋废城航天大楼）也值得一搜。

tips.en: Recycling at home returns a Sensors and a Speaker Component; salvaging in raid gives only the Speaker Component.
tips.zh: 回基地回收得传感器和扬声器零件各 1 个；局内拆解只有扬声器零件。

verdict.en: Recycle it for 7 Plastic Parts and a Sensor, or sell for 1000; nothing needs it.
verdict.zh: 拆成7个塑料零件和1个传感器，或卖1000钱币，没有任何需求。

obtain.en: Residential loot, so living rooms and apartments. On Buried City the Residential areas are Santa Maria Houses, the Red Tower and Grandioso Apartments; on The Blue Gate, the Village, Raider's Refuge and Ruined Homestead.
obtain.zh: 住宅类物资，也就是客厅和公寓。掩埋废城的住宅区是圣玛丽亚住宅区、红塔和奢华公寓；蓝门是村庄、奇袭者避难所和废弃农庄。

tips.en: Light at 0.8 weight, so it is cheap to carry. Salvaging in raid only gives 1 Sensors, so recycle at the workshop.
tips.zh: 重量仅0.8，带着不占负担。战局内分解只有1传感器，回营地拆解更划算。

verdict.en: Low-value junk: sell it, or salvage it in raid for 8 Fabric if you need cloth.
verdict.zh: 低价值杂物：卖掉；缺布料时战局内分解可得8布料。

obtain.en: Industrial loot with no named spot. The largest Industrial areas are the Stacking Yard on Riven Tides (55 container spots in an ordinary round) and the Railyard on Pendola Pass (49), then Adorned Wreckage on The Blue Gate (21).
obtain.zh: 工业类物资，没有点名位置。工业类最大的区域是裂潮镇的堆料场（普通对局约55个容器点）和彭多拉山口的铁路站场（约49个），其次是蓝门的庄严残骸（约21个）。

tips.en: Unusual item: salvaging (8 Fabric) returns far more than recycling (1 Durable Cloth, 1 Magnet). Choose by what you need.
tips.zh: 这件反常：分解得8布料，比拆解（1耐磨布料、1磁铁）多得多，按需选择。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: it is a good 2,000-coin sell.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：值 2000 钱币，直接卖。

obtain.en: Exodus loot. The Spaceport's Rocket Assembly is the best-rated spot (breachable panels on the thruster sections, the big rack by the loading dock). Stella Montis also works (thruster panels, luggage rack by the Lobby to Atrium battery door), and Riven Tides' Port Authority is listed.
obtain.zh: 出在“出埃及”类区域。太空港火箭组装区评价最高（推进器部位的可破拆面板、装卸口旁的大货架）；星辰山（推进器面板、大厅通往中庭电池门旁的行李架）和裂潮镇港务局也有。

tips.en: Recycling gives 6 Metal Parts and 2 Synthesized Fuel, double the fuel of salvaging, but the sale pays more.
tips.zh: 回收得 6 个金属零件和 2 个合成燃料，燃料比局内拆解多一倍，但卖掉更赚。

tips.en: Recycling gives 6 Metal Parts and 2 Synthesized Fuel, double the fuel of salvaging.
tips.zh: 拆解得6金属零件和2合成燃料，燃料比分解多一倍。

verdict.en: Keep one for the With a View quest, then it is a 3000-coin sell or a Processor recycle.
verdict.zh: 留1个做“风景如画”，之后卖3000钱币或拆处理器。

obtain.en: Stella Montis only, as random container loot. The Assembly Workshops are the usual safest pick; the Medical area, Business Center and Lobby security office are also named. It does not drop from enemies and cannot be bought.
obtain.zh: 只在星辰山的容器里随机刷新。组装厂车间通常最安全，医疗区、商务中心和大厅安保室也被提到。敌人不掉落，也买不到。

tips.en: Put it in your Safe Pocket as soon as you find it; the quest needs it at an Assembly control room, and a friend can hand it to you.
tips.zh: 拿到后立刻放进安全口袋；任务要在组装区控制室使用，队友也可以转交。

tips.en: The quest also needs an Ion Sputter from an Exodus-type spot, so plan both.
tips.zh: 这个任务还需要一个离子溅射仪，需到“出埃及”类区域找，一并规划。

verdict.en: Recycle it only if you need Rubber Parts (18 per pad); otherwise sell for 1000.
verdict.zh: 只有缺橡胶零件时才拆（每块18个），否则卖1000钱币。

obtain.en: Electrical loot around machinery and power facilities. Electrical-tagged areas include the Electrical Substation and Power Generation Complex on Dam Battlegrounds, Pilgrim's Peak and Maintenance Wing on The Blue Gate, and Communications on Stella Montis.
obtain.zh: 电气类物资，多在机械和电力设施周围。带电气标签的区域有大坝战场的变电站和发电厂综合体，蓝门的朝圣峰和维护区辅楼，星辰山的通讯站。

tips.en: Salvaging in raid gives 12 Rubber Parts, recycling 18. At 2.0 weight, do not haul several out unless you are crafting.
tips.zh: 战局内分解12个橡胶零件，拆解18个。重量2.0，不做制作就别带多块。

verdict.en: A bulky 2000-coin sell; recycle only if you want lots of Rubber Parts.
verdict.zh: 体积大的2000钱币卖品；要大量橡胶零件才拆。

obtain.en: Residential loot from homes and apartments; no specific spawn point is documented. Santa Maria Houses on Buried City has the most Residential containers of the older maps (19 in an ordinary round).
obtain.zh: 来自民居和公寓的住宅类物资，没有记录具体刷新点。老地图里住宅容器最多的是掩埋废城的圣玛丽亚住宅区（普通对局约19个）。

tips.en: Recycling gives 18 Rubber Parts and 3 Steel Spring. At weight 3, free the slot if it is not worth the coins.
tips.zh: 拆解得18橡胶零件和3钢质弹簧。重量3，不值得就别占格子。

verdict.en: Cheap junk: recycle for Metal Parts, or sell for 640.
verdict.zh: 廉价杂物：拆成金属零件，或卖640钱币。

obtain.en: Security loot from checkpoints and guard rooms. If you run Dam Battlegrounds, the Security containers are in the Hydroponic Dome Complex (15 in an ordinary round) and the Control Tower (7).
obtain.zh: 安保类物资，来自检查站和警卫室。跑大坝战场的话，安保类容器在水培穹顶综合体（普通对局约15个）和控制塔（约7个）。

tips.en: Recycling returns 6 Metal Parts and 3 Rubber Parts, more than the 4 Metal Parts from salvaging.
tips.zh: 拆解得6金属零件和3橡胶零件，比分解的4金属零件多。

verdict.en: A 1000-coin sell: it cannot be recycled or used for anything.
verdict.zh: 只能卖1000钱币，既不能拆解也没有用途。

obtain.en: Not found in containers: an unused Emperor Beacon turns into this when you extract with it. Use the beacon in the same run (on Pendola Pass during Redirection) or you only get this.
obtain.zh: 不会在容器里刷出：带着未使用的“帝王”信标撤离时会变成它。想要正经收益，就在本局用掉信标（航向重定向期间的彭多拉山口）。

tips.en: Stacks to 8 at 0.5 weight, so selling a batch is easy.
tips.zh: 可堆叠8个，重量0.5，攒一批再卖很方便。

verdict.en: Cheap junk: recycle for 8 Metal Parts, or sell for 640.
verdict.zh: 廉价杂物：拆成8个金属零件，或卖640钱币。

obtain.en: Security loot. The Blue Gate holds the most of it: Security Wing (26 container spots in an ordinary round) and Reinforced Reception (12).
obtain.zh: 安保类物资。蓝门最多：安保区辅楼（普通对局约26个容器点）和加固前台（约12个）。

tips.en: Salvaging in raid gives only 4 Metal Parts; recycle at the workshop for double.
tips.zh: 战局内分解只有4金属零件，回营地拆解翻倍。

verdict.en: Nothing live needs it: sell for 640 coins, or recycle for 10 Fabric.
verdict.zh: 没有进行中的需求：卖 640 钱币，或回收 10 个布料。

obtain.en: Exodus loot, so look where other Exodus items spawn, such as the Spaceport's Rocket Assembly or Stella Montis. No parachute-specific spot is documented.
obtain.zh: 出在“出埃及”类区域，去其他同类物品刷新的地方找，如太空港火箭组装区或星辰山。没有降落伞专属刷新点的记录。

tips.en: Recycling at home returns 10 Fabric against 5 from salvaging in a raid.
tips.zh: 回基地回收得 10 个布料，局内拆解只有 5 个。

tips.en: Recycling returns 10 Fabric against 5 from salvaging.
tips.zh: 拆解得10布料，分解只有5。

verdict.en: Recycle for Plastic and Rubber Parts if you craft; otherwise a plain 1000-coin sell.
verdict.zh: 做制作才拆塑料和橡胶零件；否则直接卖1000钱币。

obtain.en: Security loot from guard rooms and checkpoints. On The Spaceport the only Security area is the Launch Towers (16 container spots in an ordinary round).
obtain.zh: 安保类物资，来自警卫室和检查站。太空港唯一的安保区是发射塔（普通对局约16个容器点）。

tips.en: Recycling adds 6 Rubber Parts on top of the 10 Plastic Parts that salvaging gives.
tips.zh: 拆解比分解多出6个橡胶零件，塑料零件两者都是10个。

verdict.en: Cheap junk: sell for 640, or recycle if you want Fabric and a Magnet.
verdict.zh: 廉价杂物：卖640钱币，需要布料和磁铁时再拆。

obtain.en: Security loot. Security-tagged areas are few: Security Wing and Reinforced Reception on The Blue Gate, the Launch Towers on The Spaceport, and the Hydroponic Dome Complex and Control Tower on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 安保类物资，带标签的区域很少：蓝门的安保区辅楼和加固前台，太空港的发射塔，大坝战场的水培穹顶综合体和控制塔。

tips.en: Recycling is the only way to get the Magnet; salvaging yields Fabric alone.
tips.zh: 想要磁铁只能拆解；分解只得布料。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for Trophy Display phase 1; recycle or sell the rest.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个给战利品展示架第 1 阶段，其余回收或卖掉。

obtain.en: Industrial and Mechanical loot: cabinets, shipping container drawers and lockers rather than open shelves. Stella Montis' Assembly Workshops and Loading Bay are the most recommended farm.
obtain.zh: 工业和机械类战利品，常在柜子、集装箱抽屉和储物柜里，而不是开放货架。星辰山的组装厂车间和装卸区最常被推荐。

tips.en: Recycling gives 8 Metal Parts, salvaging 4, so only break down extras.
tips.zh: 拆解8金属零件，分解4个，多余的才拆。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Gunsmith level 3 upgrade, then it is a 2000-coin sell.
verdict.zh: 留3个给武器工作台3级升级，之后卖2000钱币。

obtain.en: Spawns on most maps in car hoods, bus rear trunks and panels, car tool cabinets, control panels, metal crates, generators and industrial drawers. Blue Gate (Checkpoint, Warehouse), Dam (Scrap Yard, Water Treatment Control), Spaceport (Rocket Assembly, Vehicle Maintenance) and Buried City (Parking Garage, Warehouse) are listed. Divided also rewards 1.
obtain.zh: 多数地图都有：汽车引擎盖、大巴后备箱和面板、汽车工具柜、控制面板、金属箱、发电机、工业抽屉。蓝门（检查站、仓库）、大坝（废料场、水处理控制室）、太空港（火箭组装区、车辆维护区）、掩埋废城（停车场、仓库）。完成“分歧”也奖励1个。

tips.en: Blue Gate has the most cars and buses but is busy; bring fast exits and a Safe Pocket item so a knockout does not cost you the gear.
tips.zh: 蓝门车多大巴多但人也多；带好快速脱身手段，并用安全口袋保住它。

tips.en: Gunsmith 3 also needs 5 Advanced Mechanical Components and 4 Sentinel Firing Cores.
tips.zh: 武器工作台3级还要5个高级机械元件和4个“哨卫”发射核心。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Medical Lab level 3 upgrade, and don't recycle early; afterwards it is a 2000-coin sell.
verdict.zh: 留3个给医疗实验室3级升级，别提前拆；之后卖2000钱币。

obtain.en: Medical loot (cabinets, shelves, medical boxes). Dam's Testing Annex is the best-supported farm, Buried City's Hospital is the other pick but is often contested and looted early. Expect the odd hostile inside.
obtain.zh: 医疗类战利品（药柜、货架、医药箱）。大坝测试附楼最被推荐，掩埋废城医院是另一选择，但常有人抢，容易被早早搜空。里面偶尔会有敌人。

tips.en: Medical Lab 3 also needs 8 Antiseptic and 5 ARC Surveyor Vaults; Antiseptic tends to be found in the same places.
tips.zh: 医疗实验室 3 级还要 8 个防腐剂和 5 个ARC勘测师保险库，防腐剂通常在同一批地点能找到。

tips.en: After the upgrade, recycling gives 2 Syringe plus 1 Antiseptic; salvaging gives only the Syringes.
tips.zh: 升级后拆解得2注射器加1防腐剂，分解只有注射器。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Gunsmith level 2 upgrade; after that it is just a heavy 1,000-coin sell.
verdict.zh: 留3个升武器工作台2级，之后当1000钱币的卖品即可。

obtain.en: Rolls in Mechanical loot on every map. Dam Battlegrounds is best documented: Power Generation Complex, Scrap Yard cars, and the lockers in the Field Depot and the building next to it. Bus trunks and Metal Crates also drop it.
obtain.zh: 各地图的机械类战利品里都有。大坝战场最稳：发电厂综合体、废料场的车辆，以及前线仓库和旁边建筑的储物柜；公交车后备箱和金属箱也会出。

tips.en: It is Rare and the drop rate is low, so start collecting before you are ready to upgrade.
tips.zh: 掉率不高，别等到要升级才开始攒。

tips.en: Recycling gives 8 Metal Parts and a Steel Spring, which is worth less than the 1,000 sell price unless you are short on Metal Parts.
tips.zh: 回收只得8个金属零件和1个钢质弹簧，除非缺金属零件，否则不如直接卖1000钱币。

verdict.en: A 3,000-coin lab trinket; sell it, or recycle it only if you want Electrical Components or seeds.
verdict.zh: 3000钱币的实验室杂物，直接卖；缺电子元件或种子时再回收。

obtain.en: Scavenged only, no fixed spawn. The community wiki lists Stella Montis; guides say to sweep indoor lab, medical and workshop rooms, checking tables and shelves.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，没有固定刷新点。社区维基记在星辰山；攻略建议扫室内的实验室、医疗和车间，翻桌面和货架。

tips.en: Recycling yields 14 Assorted Seeds and 2 Electrical Components. In a raid, salvaging gives only seeds, so recycle at the workshop instead.
tips.zh: 回收得14个混合种子和2个电子元件；局内拆解只有种子，回基地再回收更划算。

verdict.en: Pure sell-or-recycle loot: 3,000 coins, nothing in the workshop needs it.
verdict.zh: 纯卖或回收的战利品，3000钱币，工作台和任务都不需要。

obtain.en: Stella Montis, Exodus-tagged loot. Guides point to Medical Research, the Assembly Workshop, Sandbox and Seed Vault, and the red lockers in the small server room beside the Auditorium and Business Lounge.
obtain.zh: 星辰山的离巢类战利品。攻略推荐医学研究部、组装厂车间、机器人沙盘和种子库，以及礼堂与商务休息室旁小服务器间的红色储物柜。

tips.en: Recycling gives 2 Electrical Components and 2 Voltage Converter; sell it if you only want coins.
tips.zh: 回收得2个电子元件和2个变电器；只要钱就直接卖。

verdict.en: Sell it for 3,000, or recycle for Advanced Electrical Components when you need them.
verdict.zh: 卖3000钱币；需要高级电子元件时再回收。

obtain.en: Stella Montis scavenging, in the same Exodus-tagged tech rooms as the Spectrum Analyzer: Medical Research, Assembly and Sandbox. No fixed container.
obtain.zh: 星辰山搜刮，与频谱分析仪同属离巢类科技房间：医学研究部、组装厂和机器人沙盘，没有固定容器。

tips.en: Recycling returns 1 Advanced Electrical Components and 1 Sensors, better than salvaging in a raid (2 Electrical Components).
tips.zh: 回收得1个高级电子元件和1个传感器，比局内拆解（2个电子元件）更好。

verdict.en: Epic and worth 3,500, but recycle it if you need Exodus Modules.
verdict.zh: 史诗品质卖3500，但缺离巢模块时应回收。

obtain.en: Stella Montis only, scavenged. Players report Medical Research, Assembly, Lobby Metro and Sandbox; try shelves, lockers and equipment piles in labs and server rooms near the Auditorium.
obtain.zh: 仅星辰山，靠搜刮。玩家常在医学研究部、组装厂、大厅地铁站和机器人沙盘找到；实验室和礼堂附近服务器间的货架、储物柜值得翻。

tips.en: Recycling gives 1 Exodus Modules and 1 Sensors. Salvaging in a raid gives 2 Processors, handy if you need those mid-run.
tips.zh: 回收得1个离巢模块和1个传感器；局内拆解得2个处理器。

verdict.en: Sell it for 2,000; the recycle output is not worth more.
verdict.zh: 卖2000钱币，回收产出不比这值钱。

obtain.en: Residential and Commercial loot with no specific container. Old Town and the Commissary Supermarket on Pendola Pass sit side by side and cover both types with over 100 container spots between them.
obtain.zh: 住宅和商业类物资，没有特定容器。彭多拉山口的老城区和军需超市相邻，两类都有，加起来超过100个容器点。

tips.en: Recycling returns 2 Durable Cloth and 2 Steel Spring. Nothing in the workshop or projects uses it.
tips.zh: 回收得2个耐磨布料和2个钢质弹簧；工作台和项目都不需要它。

verdict.en: A 2.0 crafting part: keep a few for gadget blueprints and the Tether Launcher, otherwise it barely sells.
verdict.zh: 2.0新增的制作材料：留几根给装置蓝图和系索发射器，卖不了几个钱。

use.en: Steel Cable feeds the Yank Grenade Blueprint (8 cables, Research Station 1), the Tether Launcher Blueprint and craft, and the Zipline. Unlock the blueprints first, then spend cables on crafting.
use.zh: 钢缆用于系索弹蓝图（研究站1级，需8根）、系索发射器蓝图及其制作，还有滑索。先解锁蓝图，再拿钢缆制作。

obtain.en: Scavenged with no named spawn on the community wiki. Celeste sells it for 20 Assorted Seeds each, limit 5, which is the reliable route.
obtain.zh: 社区维基未列出具体刷新点。塞莱斯特用20个混合种子出售一根，限购5根，这是稳定来源。

tips.en: At 270 coins it is not worth selling or recycling for 1 Wires.
tips.zh: 只值270钱币，回收也只得1个导线，不值得卖或拆。

verdict.en: Low-value fabric filler; sell it for 640, or recycle it for Fabric if you need healing supplies.
verdict.zh: 低价值的布料来源，卖640钱币；需要布料时再回收。

obtain.en: Residential areas by scavenging; no specific container is listed. Raider's Refuge (12 container spots in an ordinary round) and the Village (33) on The Blue Gate are dense Residential stops.
obtain.zh: 在住宅区搜到，没有列出特定容器。蓝门的奇袭者避难所（普通对局约12个容器点）和村庄（约33个）住宅容器密集。

tips.en: Recycling gives 11 Fabric, but guides put Fabric near 50 coins each, so selling is usually equal or better.
tips.zh: 回收得11个布料，但攻略里布料单价约50钱币，卖通常更好或持平。

verdict.en: Recycle it for Advanced Electrical Components and a Processor; sell only when you are cash-poor.
verdict.zh: 回收取高级电子元件和处理器，缺钱时才卖3000。

obtain.en: Stella Montis. Guides rate the Workshops (white and blue crates, north rooms), the Assembly Workshop, Medblock and the Lobby east stairs. Lobby and Assembly are busy PvP zones.
obtain.zh: 星辰山。攻略推荐车间（北侧房间的白色和蓝色箱子）、组装厂车间、医疗区和大厅东侧楼梯；大厅和组装厂PvP很多。

tips.en: Advanced Electrical Components are needed for Raider Hatch Keys, and Processors for Trigger Grenades, so the parts beat the sell price.
tips.zh: 高级电子元件用于造奇袭者暗门钥匙，处理器用于造触发手雷，拆件通常比卖划算。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Research Station level 4 upgrade; they are scarce, so do not recycle.
verdict.zh: 留3个升研究站4级，数量稀少，别拿去回收。

obtain.en: New in 2.0. Best reported spot is the Observatory on Pendola Pass (kitchen, tables, storage lockers), close to an extract, but only about one per visit. It can also drop in other Technological and Electrical containers.
obtain.zh: 2.0新物品。目前最推荐彭多拉山口的天文台（厨房、桌椅、储物间柜子），离撤离点近，但每趟通常只有一个；其他科技和电气类容器也可能出。

tips.en: The upgrade also needs 3 ARC Data Modules and a Frigate Inductor, so start the Shaker hunt early.
tips.zh: 该升级还需要3个ARC数据模块和1个护卫者感应器，所以要早点开始凑摇铃（恒温振荡仪）。

verdict.en: Sell it for 1,000; recycling gives rubber and a sensor worth less.
verdict.zh: 卖1000钱币，回收的橡胶和传感器价值更低。

obtain.en: Residential areas by scavenging; no specific container is documented. Hotel Panorama Azzurro on Riven Tides (40 container spots in an ordinary round) and Researcher Lodgings on Pendola Pass (37) are the large Residential areas on the new maps.
obtain.zh: 在住宅区搜到，没有记录特定容器。新地图上大的住宅区是裂潮镇的蔚蓝全景酒店（普通对局约40个容器点）和彭多拉山口的研究员住所区（约37个）。

tips.en: MetaForge shows a recycle value below the sell price. Recycle only if you want the 7 Rubber Parts or the Sensors.
tips.zh: 第三方数据站显示回收价值低于卖价；只有想要7个橡胶零件或传感器时才回收。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Refiner level 2 upgrade, then sell the rest.
verdict.zh: 留3个升精加工机2级，其余卖掉。

obtain.en: Residential interiors. Destructoid rates the Spaceport Departure and Arrival buildings best (tables upstairs), others cite Blue Gate's village and Dam's Pale Apartments, Ruby Residence and Pattern House. Reports disagree on whether it sits in cabinets or lies loose.
obtain.zh: 住宅内部。太空港的候机楼和到达楼最被看好（楼上桌面），也有人提蓝门村落，以及大坝的苍白公寓、红宝石宅邸和壁画屋。关于是否在柜子里，各来源说法不一。

tips.en: The upgrade also needs ARC Motion Cores and Fireball Burners from ARC, so gather Toasters on the way.
tips.zh: 升级还需要ARC掉落的运动核心和火球燃烧器，可顺路收集烤面包机。

verdict.en: Low-value fabric; sell it for 640 unless you want 12 Fabric.
verdict.zh: 低价值布料，卖640钱币，除非你要12个布料。

obtain.en: Residential and Medical areas. Piazza Arbusto on Buried City carries Medical loot (33 container spots in an ordinary round) and the Santa Maria Houses Residential, so one Buried City trip covers both.
obtain.zh: 住宅和医疗区都有。掩埋废城的阿布斯托广场有医疗类物资（普通对局约33个容器点），圣玛丽亚住宅区是住宅类，跑一趟掩埋废城两类都能覆盖。

tips.en: Recycling returns 12 Fabric versus 5 from in-raid salvage, so recycle at the workshop if you do.
tips.zh: 回收得12个布料，局内拆解只有5个，要拆就回基地回收。

verdict.en: Heavy and only worth 2,000; sell it or recycle for Oil and a Mechanical Component.
verdict.zh: 又重又只值2000，卖掉，或回收取机油和机械元件。

obtain.en: Exodus-tagged. One 2026 guide names Dam's Hydroponic Dome Complex and Water Treatment Control, Spaceport's Vehicle Maintenance and Container Storage, and Stella Montis assembly workshops. Treat these as a single source.
obtain.zh: 离巢类。有攻略提到大坝的水培穹顶综合体和水处理控制中心、太空港的载具维护区和集装箱仓库，以及星辰山组装厂车间；仅为单一来源。

tips.en: At 3 weight it eats space fast. Salvaging in a raid gives 3 Steel Spring, but nothing needs the pump itself.
tips.zh: 重量3，很占背包。局内拆解得3个钢质弹簧，但没有任何升级或任务需要它。

verdict.en: Recycle it for 5 Simple Gun Parts if you craft, otherwise sell for 2,000.
verdict.zh: 要造东西就回收取5个简易枪械零件，否则卖2000。

obtain.en: Listed under Security containers; the sources do not name maps or areas, and Security containers need the Security Breach skill to open.
obtain.zh: 记在安保类容器下，来源没写具体地图或区域；安保容器需要解锁“安保破拆”技能才能打开。

tips.en: Also needed for the Tether Launcher Blueprint (1 piece plus cables). Otherwise 2,000 coins beats the recycle output unless you lack Simple Gun Parts.
tips.zh: 系索发射器蓝图需要1个。其他情况下2000钱币高于回收产出，除非你缺简易枪械零件。

verdict.en: Keep 2 for the Dolabra; any extras sell for 6,000 each.
verdict.zh: 留2个做“錾斧”，多余的每个可卖6000钱币。

use.en: Two go into the Dolabra at Gunsmith 3. No live project asks for it, so anything beyond those 2 is better sold or recycled into ARC Circuitry and Advanced Electrical Components.
use.zh: “錾斧”在武器工作台3级需要2个。目前没有进行中的项目要它，多出来的卖掉，或回收成ARC线圈和高级电子元件。

obtain.en: Kill a Vaporizer, which appears only in the Close Scrutiny map condition around the Assessor probe. Beebom says the Regulator is guaranteed. ARC Couriers rarely carry one.
obtain.zh: 击杀“汽化者”，它只在“严密排查”地图条件下出现，守在评估探针旁。有攻略称调节器必掉；ARC运输机偶尔也带。

tips.en: Vaporizers have an energy shield that blocks thrown grenades, so bring a full loadout and look at the Close Scrutiny probe location first.
tips.zh: “汽化者”的能量护盾能挡投掷物，装备要带足，先看“严密排查”探针位置。

verdict.en: Sell it for 1,000; no live project or upgrade needs it.
verdict.zh: 卖1000钱币，目前没有项目或升级需要它。

obtain.en: Industrial loot, mostly Metal Crates. Dam Battlegrounds' Research and Administration west tunnels and Power Generation Complex, and the Spaceport Shipping Warehouse are listed. One guide suggests Buried City.
obtain.zh: 工业类战利品，多在金属箱里。大坝战场的研究与行政区西侧隧道、发电厂综合体，以及太空港货运仓库有记录；有攻略推荐掩埋废城。

tips.en: Recycle only if you need Canisters or Rubber Parts; selling for 1,000 usually pays more.
tips.zh: 只在缺小罐或橡胶零件时回收，卖1000通常更划算。

verdict.en: Sell it for 1,000; no live project or upgrade needs it.
verdict.zh: 卖1000钱币，目前没有项目或升级需要它。

obtain.en: Metal Crates in industrial areas: Dam Battlegrounds Research and Administration west tunnels and Power Generation Complex, and Spaceport Shipping Warehouse. Carts and shelves too.
obtain.zh: 工业区域的金属箱：大坝战场研究与行政区西侧隧道、发电厂综合体，以及太空港货运仓库；推车和货架上也会出现。

tips.en: Recycle only if you need Metal Parts or Oil; selling for 1,000 usually pays more.
tips.zh: 只在缺金属零件或油时回收，卖1000通常更划算。
